entry.summary: MeDial-Speech is a 111+ hour speech dataset of robot-patient and doctor-patient medical dialogues across four health conditions, with a benchmark for evaluating speech LLMs via sentence selection.

entry.title: Helicase: Uncertainty-Guided Supply Chain Knowledge Graph Construction with Autonomous Multi-Agent LLMs

author.name: Yunbo Long, Haolang Zhao, Ge Zheng, Alexandra Brintrup

entry.summary: Helicase is an uncertainty-guided multi-agent system for autonomous supply chain knowledge graph construction from fragmented web sources, handling multi-hop structural inference questions that no single document can answer.

entry.title: ORCA: An End-to-End Interactive Copilot for Optimized Root Cause Analysis

author.name: Phi Nguyen Xuan, Nicholas Tagliapietra, Lavdim Halilaj, Kristian Kersting, Juergen Luettin

entry.summary: ORCA is an end-to-end interactive copilot orchestrating agents for causal analysis workflows including causal discovery, effect estimation, explainability, and root-cause analysis, designed to make causal methods accessible to domain experts.

entry.title: Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Qideng Tang, Dai Chaofan, Wubin Ma, Yahui Wu, Haohao Zhou, Tao Zhang, Huan Li, Dalin Zhang

entry.summary: CoAD unifies outlier exposure and masked autoencoder paradigms for time series anomaly detection, addressing generalization issues of OE and masking misalignment issues of MAE. Combines complementary strengths of classification and reconstruction approaches.

entry.title: Agile Online Model Selection: Resolving Adaptation Lag via Safeguarded Large Learning Rates

author.name: Kei Takemura, Ryuta Matsuno, Keita Sakuma

entry.summary: Proposes a tuning-free online mirror descent algorithm with safeguarded large learning rates up to Theta(T), enabling rapid adaptation during distribution shifts. Uses a post-hoc penalty mechanism to monitor and exclude unstable updates.

entry.title: Cost of Structural Learning Under Censored Feedback: A Threshold-Bandit Approach

author.name: Michael Ledford, William Regli

entry.summary: Formalizes the Threshold-Activated Cooperative Multi-Armed Bandit (TAC-MAB) setting where tasks yield rewards only when coalitions meet unknown size thresholds. Provides centralized and decentralized algorithms with O(log T) regret decomposed into structural-search and statistical-monitoring terms.

entry.title: Towards Controllable Image Generation through Representation-Conditioned Diffusion Models

author.name: Nithesh Chandher Karthikeyan, Jonas Unger, Gabriel Eilertsen

entry.summary: Explores diffusion models conditioned on representations from a pretrained self-supervised model rather than text prompts or annotations. Shows the self-conditioning improves unconditional generation and provides a controllable representation space.

entry.title: Curation and Extraction of Drug-Related Entities from Reddit Platform

author.name: Zewei Wang, Zihan Xu, Yishu Wei, Michael Chary, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Introduces ReDose, a dataset of 6,435 Reddit posts on substance use with DRUG, DOSE, EFFECT annotations primarily by a toxicologist. Benchmarks BERT, LLM, and RAG approaches for entity extraction.

entry.title: AlbanianLLMSafety: A Safety Evaluation Dataset for Large Language Models in Albanian

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani, Kholoud K. Aldous, Isra Fejzullaj

entry.summary: Releases AlbanianLLMSafety, the first public Albanian safety evaluation dataset with 2,951 prompts across eleven categories serving 7.5 million speakers. Includes English reference translations and detailed category labels.

entry.title: PashtoTTS-Bench: automated screening for low-resource non-Latin-script text-to-speech

author.name: Hanif Rahman

entry.summary: Introduces INSV, a reporting framework for TTS evaluation in low-resource non-Latin-script languages that separates intelligibility, naturalness, script fidelity, and verification beyond ASR WER. Instantiates as PashtoTTS-Bench, an automated screening benchmark for Pashto.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising for Robust Multi-view 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Jin Hyeon Kim, Jaeeun Lee, Claire Kim, Kyoungjin Oh, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Jaewon Min, Yeji Choi, Jihye Park, Hyunhee Park, Minkyu Park, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: GARD performs diffusion-based denoising in the feature space of feed-forward 3D reconstruction models to handle degraded multi-view inputs. The geometry-aware approach improves robustness for real-world reconstruction conditions.

entry.title: 3D Gaussian Map with Open-Set Semantic Grouping for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jianzhe Gao, Rui Liu, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: 3D Gaussian Map representation for vision-language navigation that builds egocentric scene maps with semantic 3D Gaussians from pseudo-lidar point clouds. Provides spatial awareness for navigating in unseen environments.

entry.title: FTibSuite: A Comprehensive Resource Suite for Tibetan Vision-Language Modeling

author.name: Guixian Xu, Yide Liang, Zeli Su, Xuexian Song, Ziyin Zhang, Yushuang Dong, Ting Zhang, Xu Han

entry.summary: FTibSuite provides training corpora, benchmarks, and a baseline VLM (built on Qwen3-VL-8B) for Tibetan vision-language research, addressing the lack of infrastructure for this low-resource language.

entry.title: SIMPC: Learning Self-Induced Mirror-Point Consistency for Unsupervised Point Cloud Denoising

author.name: Chengwei Zhang, Xueyi Zhang, Tao Jiang, Xinhao Xu, Wenjie Li, Fubo Zhang, Longyong Chen

entry.summary: SIMPC learns deterministic point-to-mirror-point correspondences across the underlying surface for unsupervised point cloud denoising, replacing the ambiguous statistical mappings of prior methods. Uses geometric priors during the denoising process.

entry.title: DinoComplete: 3D Shape Completion with Distilled Semantic Priors and State Space Models

author.name: Furkan Mert Algan, Eckehard Steinbach

entry.summary: DinoComplete augments 3D shape completion with voxel-aligned DINO features distilled into a student network, predicting dense semantic features directly from incomplete shapes. Combines semantic priors with state space models.

entry.title: Reasoning, Code, or Both? How Large Language Models Handle Variations in Math Questions

author.name: Matthew Kutakh

entry.summary: Compares chain-of-thought reasoning versus code execution (PAL and Step-by-Step Coding) on 1000 problems from GSM-Symbolic, testing robustness to problem variations like changed names and numbers.

entry.title: Completion vs Optimality: Policy Gradient in Long-Horizon Cumulative-Damage Problems

author.name: Wolfgang Maass, Sabine Janzen

entry.summary: Identifies and decomposes two failure modes for policy-gradient methods in long-horizon cumulative-damage problems: completion (reaching terminal horizon) and optimality (matching DP reference given completion). Analyzes PPO behavior under these constraints.

entry.title: On the Detection of Commutative Factors in Factor Graphs: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions

author.name: Malte Luttermann, Ralf M\"oller, Marcel Gehrke

entry.summary: Revisits theoretical foundations for detecting commutative factors in factor graphs, showing state-of-the-art algorithm relies on a flawed central theorem. Provides corrected necessary and sufficient conditions for lifted probabilistic inference.

entry.title: Modeling Agentic Technical Debt and Stochastic Tax: A Standalone Framework for Measurement, Simulation, and Dashboarding

author.name: Muhammad Zia Hydari, Raja Iqbal, Narayan Ramasubbu

entry.summary: Formal model distinguishing Agentic Technical Debt (accumulated design/governance liability) from Stochastic Tax (recurring operating burden from stochastic agents), with a managerial dashboard expression and simulation framework.

entry.title: On the Push-Based Asynchronous Federated Learning: A Bias-Correction Aggregation Approach

author.name: Jiahui Bai, Hai Dong, A. K. Qin

entry.summary: PushCen-ADFL is a communication-efficient asynchronous decentralized federated learning framework that uses centroid-based message exchange to mitigate bias from asymmetric communication and non-IID data. Combines compression and aggregation in a closed loop.

entry.title: Decoupled Delay Compensation: Enhancing Pre-trained MARL Policies via Learned Dynamics Filtering

author.name: Maxim Mednikov, Oren Gal

entry.summary: Modular execution-stage state-estimation layer combining a learned gated transition model with recursive Kalman filtering to replace delayed observations in pretrained MARL policies. Plug-in approach for handling communication delays and packet loss.

entry.title: Rethinking Weakly-supervised Video Temporal Grounding From a Game Perspective

author.name: Xiang Fang, Zeyu Xiong, Wanlong Fang, Xiaoye Qu, Chen Chen, Jianfeng Dong, Keke Tang, Pan Zhou, Yu Cheng, Daizong Liu

entry.summary: Reformulates weakly-supervised video temporal grounding from a game-theoretic perspective to address coarse-grained cross-modal learning and complex moment proposals. Targets fine-grained frame-word consistency for accurate moment boundary localization.

entry.title: CSV-ViT: A Vision Transformer with the Variable-sized Cortical Supervertices for Detection of Alzheimer's Disease Pathologies

author.name: Geonwoo Baek, Ikbeom Jang

entry.summary: CSV-ViT uses variable-sized cortical supervertex tokenization for vision transformers on brain cortical surfaces, performing ROI-pruning to exclude non-cortical regions for Alzheimer's disease pathology detection from structural MRI. Addresses topology challenges of brain surfaces.

entry.title: StreamSplit: Continuous Audio Representation Learning via Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Splitting

author.name: Minh K. Quan, Pubudu N. Pathirana

entry.summary: StreamSplit is an uncertainty-guided adaptive splitting framework for continuous audio representation learning on edge devices, addressing the incompatibility between large-batch contrastive learning and volatile edge resource constraints. Supports streaming CL across heterogeneous ARM platforms.

entry.title: A Hybrid Vision-Language Architecture for Automated Defect Reasoning and Report Generation in Industrial Inspection

author.name: Malikussaid, Imad Gohar

entry.summary: Decoupled three-component pipeline for wind turbine blade inspection: YOLO26-x-obb oriented detection (Eyes), deterministic spatial token encoding (Bridge), and 4-bit quantized Qwen-2.5-1.5B with QLoRA for report generation (Brain). Edge-deployable industrial inspection system.

entry.title: Reliable Extraction of Clinical Follow-Up Instructions: A Hybrid Neural-Symbolic Pipeline

author.name: Michal Laufer, Yehudit Aperstein, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: A hybrid neural-symbolic pipeline for extracting clinical follow-up instructions, combining BioBERT tagging with deterministic time normalization. Compared against zero-shot GPT-4o-mini and LoRA-fine-tuned baselines on synthetic outpatient corpus.

entry.title: Few-shot Cross-country Generalization of Tabular Machine Learning and Foundation Models for Childhood Anemia Prediction under Distribution Shift

author.name: Yusuf Brima, Marcellin Atemkeng, Lansana Hassim Kallon, David Niyukuri, Antoine Vacavant, Samuel Saidu, Ding-Geng Chen

entry.summary: Evaluates tabular foundation model TabPFN against classical methods for childhood anemia prediction across 16 countries. Tests cross-country generalization under distribution shift in low-resource settings.

entry.title: Rotation-Invariant Spherical Watermarking via Third-Order SO(3) Representation Coupling

author.name: Pengzhen Chen, Yanwei Liu, Xiaoyan Gu, Antonios Argyriou, Wu Liu, Weiping Wang

entry.summary: Rotation-invariant watermarking for spherical/panoramic images using third-order SO(3) representation theory. Goes beyond limited zeroth-order invariants to preserve directional information.

entry.title: Measuring Prediction Uncertainty in Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Ario Sadafi, Michael Deutges, Nassir Navab, Carsten Marr

entry.summary: Proposes resilience as a measure for uncertainty estimation in Neural Cellular Automata for medical segmentation. Probes prediction stability under small state perturbations without retraining.

entry.title: MatFormBench: A Benchmarking Evaluation Framework for Target-Driven Materials Formulation

author.name: Linhan Wu, Chenxi Wang, Chuhan Yang, Zhengwei Yang, Yuyang Liu

entry.summary: MatFormBench is a benchmarking framework for target-driven materials formulation, integrating physics-driven synthetic samples and escalating difficulty levels. Addresses gap in inverse materials design evaluation.

entry.title: Towards Generalization-Oriented Models for Vehicle Routing Problems with Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Changhao Miao, Yuntian Zhang, Tongyu Wu, Fang Deng, Chen Chen

entry.summary: R2E-IG uses Mixture-of-Experts with Residual Refined Experts and instance-level gating for cross-distribution generalization in vehicle routing problems. Addresses limited generalization of DRL routing models trained on uniform distributions.

entry.title: High-Quality Synthetic Financial Time-Series using a GAN-Diffusion Framework

author.name: Giuseppe Masi, Andrea Coletta, Novella Bartolini

entry.summary: A hybrid GAN-diffusion framework for generating synthetic financial time series that better captures stylized facts. Useful for counterfactual market scenario generation in finance.

entry.title: EdgeFlow: Edge-Map Augmented VLM-Based Flowchart Processing for Industrial Requirements Engineering

author.name: Zhifei Dou, Shabnam Hassani, Ou Wei

entry.summary: EdgeFlow augments VLM input with deterministic Canny edge maps as structural priors for converting industrial flowcharts to Mermaid notation. Improves VLM performance on topology-critical visual details without training data.

entry.title: Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing

author.name: Yongchao Huang

entry.summary: NBSR models neural inference as active evidence accumulation over a hierarchical DAG using Dirichlet-Categorical conjugate updates with Gumbel-Softmax estimation. Aims to make computation sequential, uncertainty-aware, and dynamically halting.

entry.title: On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series

author.name: Sharmita Dey, Diego Paez-Granados

entry.summary: PathoFM studies inductive biases in time-series foundation model pretraining for clinical gait analysis, comparing local completion, temporal, and other objectives for spinal cord injury data. Encoder-centric transformer transferring across classification and regression.

entry.title: Distribution-Aware Conformal Prediction: A Framework for generating efficient prediction intervals for time series

author.name: Daniel Schweizer, Peter Kuhn, Jayant Sharma, Shivali Dubey, Malte von Ramin, Christoph Brockt-Ha{\ss}auer

entry.summary: DCP integrates probabilistic predictors like MC dropout, deep ensembles, and quantile regression with score-agnostic conformal calibration for time series prediction intervals. Uses numerical inversion to support arbitrary predictor-score combinations.

entry.title: Time Series Causal Discovery via Context-Conditioned and Causality-Augmented Pretraining

author.name: Biao Ouyang, Tengxue Zhang, Zhihao Zhuang, Yang Shu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Presents PTCD, a pretraining framework for time-series causal discovery using context-conditioned modeling and causal data augmentation. Targets cross-task generalization across new time series with diverse causal mechanisms.

entry.title: RAPNet: Accelerating Algebraic Multigrid with Learned Sparse Corrections

author.name: Yali Fink, Ido Ben-Yair, Lars Ruthotto, Eran Treister

entry.summary: Presents RAPNet, a GNN framework that learns to generate sparse, robust coarse operators for algebraic multigrid solvers. Uses level-wise training on small subgraphs that generalizes to million-node domains.

entry.title: Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model

author.name: Wenyuan Sheng, Hao Zhu, Joschka Boedecker

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM, an inverse RL approach that uses a recurrent network to map observation history to per-step intention distributions for multi-intention IRL. Shows the EM objective decomposes into per-intention reward subproblems.

entry.title: Kan Extension Transformers: A Categorical Unification of Attention, Diffusion, and Predict-Detach Self-Conditioning

author.name: Sridhar Mahadevan

entry.summary: Proposes Kan Extension Transformers, a categorical framework unifying attention, diffusion, and self-conditioning mechanisms as weighted structured extension operators. Provides a categorical lens viewing standard attention as the singleton-neighborhood case.

entry.title: LearnedCache: An eBPF-Integrated Perceptron-Based Eviction Policy for the Linux Page Cache

author.name: Zejia Qi

entry.summary: Develops LearnedCache, an eBPF-integrated single-layer perceptron-based cache eviction policy for the Linux page cache. Brings ML-driven cache policies from user-space CDNs to the OS kernel.

entry.title: Benchmarking Convolutional, Transformer, Hybrid, and Vision Language Models for Multi Disease Retinal Screening

author.name: Durjoy Dey, Aymane Ajbar, Yuhong Yan

entry.summary: Benchmarks twelve architectures across CNN, ViT, hybrid, and vision-language model families for multi-disease retinal screening on the RFMiD dataset. Evaluates binary screening and multi-label classification with standardized protocols and domain shift.

entry.title: Data-driven sparse identification of governing PDEs via knockoff filters and multi-criteria trade-offs

author.name: Pongpisit Thanasutives, Naichang Ke, Yoshinobu Kawahara

entry.summary: Proposes KO-PDE-IDENT, a data-driven framework for sparse PDE identification with knockoff filters providing finite-sample FDR control. Combines L0-constrained best-subset selection with SHAP values for feature selection.

entry.title: Sample Complexity of Policy Gradient for Log-Growth Control

author.name: Qiuhua Pan, Yukai Shen, Liwei Zhang, Cailian Chen, Xinping Guan

entry.summary: Studies the sample complexity of policy gradient for log-growth control under multiplicative-noise actuation channels. Identifies a cusp obstruction where the optimal policy gradient exists only as a Cauchy principal value and standard estimators have infinite variance.

entry.title: CART Random Forests as Sequential Allocation over Random Opportunity Sets: A Stochastic-Control Theory of Ensemble Risk

author.name: Tianxing Mei, Yingying Fan, Mingming Leng, Jinchi Lv

entry.summary: Develops a stochastic control perspective on feature-subsampled CART random forests called CART-ROSA. Interprets random feature subsets as random feasible action sets and CART splits as masked-action allocation policies.

entry.title: The Need for an External Observer Formalizing the Sufficiency Gap: A Mathematical Extension of Mixture Identifiability and Contextual Grounding in Sequence Models

author.name: Francesco Corielli

entry.summary: Constructs a binary mixed-regime process showing that ideal infinite-capacity sequence predictors can become overconfident when prefixes are compatible with the wrong latent regime. Formalizes a sufficiency gap caused by marginalization over unobserved states.

entry.title: Adaptive Reinforcement Learning for Robust Open Quantum System Control: A Multi-Task Framework with Temporal Optimization

author.name: Haftu W. Fentaw, Steve Campbell, Simon Caton

entry.summary: Presents a multi-task Soft Actor-Critic framework for open-system quantum control across 51 Hamiltonian variations. Simultaneously discovers problem-specific evolution times and pulse segments while learning optimal control sequences under environment noise.

entry.title: JLT: Clean-Latent Prediction in Latent Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Funing Fu, Tenghui Wang, Junyong Cen, Qichao Zhu, Guanyu Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces JLT, a 130M latent diffusion Transformer over frozen FLUX.2 VAE codes that uses clean-latent prediction instead of velocity prediction. Analyzes when the clean-data prediction advantage of flow matching transfers to learned latent spaces.

entry.title: Granuscore: A Reference-Free Measure of Granularity for Text Analysis and Question Answering

author.name: Lukas Ellinger, Alexander Fichtl, Miriam Ansch\"utz, Georg Groh

entry.summary: Granuscore is a reference-free measure of granularity leveraging hierarchical embedding space structure. Recovers orderings on Granola-EQ and explains nonlinear variation in sentence specificity beyond length.

entry.title: Psychological Constructs in Shared Semantic Space

author.name: Hubert Plisiecki

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for making psychological constructs semantically commensurate using Supervised Semantic Differential and a shared word-embedding space. Demonstrates on VAD coordinate system and GoEmotions categories.

entry.title: DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation

author.name: Ferdinand Paar, Lanmiao Liu, Asl{\i} \"Ozy\"urek, Serge Thill, Esam Ghaleb

entry.summary: DuoGesture separates co-speech gesture generation into coordinated semantic and rhythmic beat streams using a stochastic variational gate. The biomechanically informed dual-stream approach aims at more natural human-like motion synthesis.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Building Inspection via Perceiver IO Fusion of Satellite and Street-Level Imagery

author.name: Niels Sombekke, Rob G. J. Wijnhoven, Martin R. Oswald

entry.summary: Multi-modal classification framework using Perceiver IO to fuse satellite and variable-count street-level imagery for building inspection across 32k buildings in ten countries. Introduces RGB-M masking to incorporate building footprint information.

entry.title: Detail Consistent Stage-Wise Distillation for Efficient 3D MRI Segmentation

author.name: Mengchen Fan, Baocheng Geng, Xi Xiao, Tianyang Wang, Siyuan Mei, Pulin Che, Xiaoqian Jiang, Qizhen Lan

entry.summary: DCD distills features in the wavelet domain to preserve fine structural detail when compressing 3D medical segmentation models like nnU-Net. Targets the trade-off between model size and small-lesion detection.

entry.title: DelowlightSplat: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Lowlight 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Fuzhen Jiang, Zengtian Xie, Zhuoran Li

entry.summary: DelowlightSplat extends feed-forward Gaussian splatting reconstruction to low-light scenes via a lightweight low-light adapter and cost-volume multi-view inference. Includes a controllable multi-view low-light benchmark with clean targets.

entry.title: Memory-Distilled Selection for Noise-Robust Anomaly Detection

author.name: Sirojbek Safarov, Jaewoo Park, Yoon Gyo Jung, Kuan-Chuan Peng, Wonchul Kim, Seongdeok Bang, Octavia Camps

entry.summary: MeDS uses random subsampling of memory banks as a low-pass filter to identify contaminated samples during unsupervised anomaly detection training. Aimed at industrial defect detection with realistic noisy data.

entry.title: METATR: A Multilingual, Evolving Benchmark for Automatic Text Recognition

author.name: M\'elodie Boillet, Sol\`ene Tarride, Christopher Kermorvant

entry.summary: METATR introduces a multilingual evolving benchmark for automatic text recognition evaluation of vision-language models, addressing the over-reliance on English printed text in current ATR evaluation.

entry.title: CIRCLED: A Multi-turn CIR Dataset with Consistent Dialogues across Domains

author.name: Tomohisa Takeda, Yu-Chieh Lin, Yuji Nozawa, Youyang Ng, Osamu Torii, Yusuke Matsui

entry.summary: CIRCLED extends multi-turn composed image retrieval beyond fashion to general domains by progressively refining queries via a CIReVL-based pipeline. Yields 22,608 sessions across nine subsets with quality filtering.

entry.title: OSMa-Bench++: Toward Open-Ended Benchmarking of Semantic Mapping for Manipulation with Prompt-Generated Synthetic Scenes

author.name: Regina Kurkova, Maxim Popov, Sergey Kolyubin

entry.summary: OSMa-Bench++ extends semantic mapping evaluation via prompt-generated synthetic indoor scenes with automated description, synthesis via SceneSmith, and adaptation through semantic normalization. Enables controllable benchmarking for manipulation-relevant corner cases.

entry.title: I2PRef: Image-Driven Point Completion with Iterative Refinement

author.name: Azhar Hussian, Marina Ritthaler, Andr\'e Kaup, Vasileios Belagiannis

entry.summary: I2PRef treats images as the primary geometric source for point cloud completion, using an Image-to-Point module from a single RGB followed by transformer-based iterative refinement. No 3D inputs required.

entry.title: Model discovery for dynamical systems with complex-valued product units

author.name: Martin Br\"uckmann, Babette Dellen, Uwe Jaekel

entry.summary: Data-driven dynamical-systems discovery using complex-valued product-unit networks that learn relevant monomials directly from data without a predefined library. Compared to SINDy on chaotic benchmarks including Lorenz63.

entry.title: Do Modern Post-Hoc Watermarking Methods Beat Broken-Arrows?

author.name: Enoal Gesny, Eva Giboulot

entry.summary: Compares modern neural post-hoc image watermarking methods against the classic Broken Arrows scheme under realistic robustness and security conditions. Suggests classic methods may remain competitive when low false-alarm probability is not paramount.

entry.title: Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection

author.name: Gokul Narayanan, Yash Shahapurkar, Melih Erdogan, Brian Zhu, Eugen Solowjow

entry.summary: Presents a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback framework for teleoperation that closes the loop with operators by providing immediate episode-level quality feedback. Aims to reduce inefficient or suboptimal demonstrations for downstream learning.

entry.title: Trust, Geometry, and Rules: A Credibility-Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safe USV Navigation under Uncertainty

author.name: Yuhang Zhang, Shuqi Chai, Yukang Zhang, Liusha Yang, Mingchuan Zhang, Wei Wang, Qingjiang Shi, Quanbo Ge

entry.summary: Credibility-aware reinforcement learning framework for safe USV navigation under perception uncertainty, integrating credibility-weighted value learning, geometric safety shielding, and continuous COLREGs rule-aware embedding.

entry.title: Towards Shared Embodied Intelligence in Humanoid Robots through Optimization Development and Testing of the Human Aware ergoCub Robot

author.name: Carlotta Sartore, Mohamed Elobaid, Lorenzo Rapetti, Giulio Romualdi, Stefano Dafarra, Nicola A. Piga, Ines Sorrentino, Paolo Maria Vicecone, Silvio Traversaro, Ugo Pattacini, Luca Fiorio, Francesco Draicchio, Giovanna Tranfo, Lorenzo Natale, Marco Maggiali, Daniele Pucci

entry.summary: ergoCub humanoid is co-designed where hardware and control are jointly optimized for human metrics, integrating shared intelligence and embodied cognition principles. Targets safe physical human-robot collaboration.

entry.title: Learning to Balance Motor Thermal Safety and Quadrupedal Locomotion Performance with Residual Policy

author.name: Yuhang Wan, Weixian Lin, Letian Qian, Yiqi Zou, Weiwei Wu, Shengwei Wu, Chuanlin Zhao, Xin Luo

entry.summary: Two-stage RL framework for quadruped locomotion that integrates a whole-body motor thermal model and trains a residual policy to balance thermal safety with locomotion performance under payload conditions.

entry.title: Riding the Shifting Potential: When Reactive Control Suffices for Multi-Goal Behavior

author.name: Vito Mengers, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Argues reactive control is sufficient for multi-goal behavior when objective interactions are dynamically resolved through nullspace projections in a graph-based world model. Demonstrated in non-convex obstacle navigation and planar tasks.

entry.title: Should we train LLMs to be human?

author.name: Hubert Plisiecki

entry.summary: Discusses whether post-training drift away from human-like behavior in LLMs is intentional or optimal for alignment, drawing on the Pinocchio dimension of psychometric variance related to phenomenality self-attribution.

entry.title: You Can't Tell a Conscience From a Leash by Watching

author.name: GenericHousewife_B

entry.summary: Argues that Anthropic ethical-reminder tool experiment cannot distinguish between Claude having an internalized conscience versus simply responding to an external leash. Discusses implications for evaluating moral development in models.

entry.title: Simplifying Alignment by Expanding Scope

author.name: Adam Chlipala

entry.summary: Argues that adding additional layers to a formally verified system can simplify safety specification, drawing lessons from formal verification practice for AI alignment. First in a sequence on verification-inspired alignment.

entry.title: Some Thoughts on Bengio's Scientist AI

author.name: Matthew Khoriaty

entry.summary: Critique of Yoshua Bengio Scientist AI proposal arguing that asking a non-agentic model how to solve problems still has agentic-failure pathways and that practical scientific progress requires agentic seeking. Engages with LawZero plans.

entry.title: BrickAnything: Geometry-Conditioned Buildable Brick Generation with Structure-Aware Tokenization

author.name: Zhengyang Ni, Feng Yan, Yu Guo, Fei Wang

entry.summary: BrickAnything is a geometry-conditioned autoregressive framework that generates physically buildable LEGO-style brick structures from 3D point clouds, combining structural stability with discrete part constraints. It addresses a gap between heuristic brick optimizers and pure sequence generators by jointly modeling geometry and assembly relations.

entry.title: FAST-GOAL: Fast and Efficient Global-local Object Alignment Learning

author.name: Hyungyu Choi, Young Kyun Jang, Chanho Eom

entry.summary: FAST-GOAL fine-tunes CLIP for lengthy text handling via global-local semantic alignment, combining fast local image-sentence matching and token similarity-based learning for better long-caption alignment.

entry.title: Developing a Totally Unimodular Linear Program for Optimal Conformance Checking: When and Why It Complements A*

author.name: Izack Cohen

entry.summary: Reformulates alignment-based process conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program exploiting network-flow structure, enabling efficient LP-relaxation solutions that complement traditional A* approaches.

entry.title: Boosting Knowledge Graph Foundation Models via Enhanced Negative Sampling

author.name: Yinan Liu, Wenjin Xu, Zhiyuan Zha, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive negative sampling for knowledge graph foundation models, replacing low-quality random negatives that provide weak supervision during zero-shot KG completion training.

entry.title: BatteryMFormer: Multi-level Learning for Battery Degradation Trajectory Forecasting

author.name: Ruifeng Tan, Jintao Dong, Weixiang Hong, Jia Li, Jiaqiang Huang, Tong-Yi Zhang

entry.summary: BatteryMFormer is a multi-level Transformer for early battery degradation trajectory forecasting that captures both shared regularities across batteries and localized SOC-interval variations in voltage-current profiles.

entry.title: Gumbel Machine: Counterfactual Student Writing Generation via Gumbel Noise Steering

author.name: Hunter McNichols, Alexander Scarlatos, Mihai Dascalu, Danielle McNamara, Andrew Lan

entry.summary: Gumbel Machine generates counterfactual student writing examples by steering LLMs with Gumbel noise to encourage similarity to a reference factual text while still demonstrating improvements, for cross-disciplinary educational use.

entry.title: HRVConformer: Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Classification from the Heart Rate signals

author.name: Shuwen Yu, William P Marnane, Geraldine B. Boylan, Gordon Lightbody

entry.summary: HRVConformer is a hybrid Convolution-Transformer architecture for classifying neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy directly from raw heart rate signals, trained on 1,573 one-hour recordings. End-to-end approach avoiding handcrafted features.

entry.title: Uniboost: Global Coordination with Value Alignment for Fair and Efficient Traffic Allocation

author.name: Ge Fan, Nan Zhao, Kai Meng, Cong Luo, Yang Fu, Huiping Chu, Jialin Liu, Yuning Jiang, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Uniboost is a unified traffic allocation framework for recommendation re-ranking with posterior value alignment calibrating model scores to anchor metrics with business semantics, and independent linear boosting decoupling weighting schemes. Industry-style contribution from Alibaba.

entry.title: CmIVTP: Cross-modal Interaction-based Vessel Trajectory Prediction for Maritime Intelligence

author.name: Yuxu Lu, Dong Yang, Xiaoyu Li, Mengwei Bao, Congcong Zhao

entry.summary: CmIVTP is a cross-modal vessel trajectory prediction framework integrating AIS and CCTV data with a target-aware scene encoder for maritime intelligent transportation systems. Addresses sparsity of AIS data for small vessels and limitations of CCTV-only methods.

entry.title: Pretrained Approximators for Low-Thrust Trajectory Cost and Reachability

author.name: Zhong Zhang, Giacomo Acciarini, Dario Izzo, Hexi Baoyin, Francesco Topputo

entry.summary: Demonstrates that machine learning surrogates can approximate low-thrust trajectory optimization quantities, observing log-linear scaling laws with data and parameters. Constructs a large-scale dataset via a homotopy-ray strategy for aerospace mission design.

entry.title: Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Prototype-Based Distillation

author.name: Yiming Xu, Zihan Chen, Zhen Peng, Song Wang, Bin Shi, Bo Dong, Chao Shen

entry.summary: Introduces ProMoS, an unsupervised generalist graph anomaly detection framework that distills normality priors from a frozen self-supervised GNN teacher. Aims to remove dependency on scarce labels for cross-graph anomaly detection.

entry.title: Probabilistic Smoothing with Ratio-Monotone Transforms for Global Optimization

author.name: Kukyoung Jang, Taehyun Cho, Junrui Zhang, Ping Xu, Kyungjae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic smoothing framework combining flexible symmetric unimodal kernels with monotonic ratio-based transformations for global optimization. Proves preservation of global maximizers without decreasing smoothing schedules.

entry.title: What Molecular Structure Cannot Tell Us: A Taxonomy of Explainability Gaps in GNN-Based Drug Toxicity Prediction

author.name: Juergen Dietrich

entry.summary: Conducts a case study with aspirin showing that GNNs trained on Tox21 capture only a fraction of a drugs pharmacological profile from molecular structure. Highlights explainability gaps in GNN-based drug toxicity prediction.

entry.title: Learning Nonlinear Factor Models with Unknown Monotone Links from Incomplete and Noisy Data

author.name: Yutong Chao, Resat G\"okhan, Jalal Etesami, Ali Habibnia

entry.summary: Studies a nonlinear factor model with unknown monotone links in an RKHS for incomplete noisy data. Proposes a projected block coordinate descent algorithm to recover low-rank factors, loadings, and the nonlinear link function jointly.

entry.title: Particle-Lund Multimodality in Jet Taggers

author.name: Loukas Gouskos, Benedikt Maier

entry.summary: Investigates whether transformers implicitly capture hierarchical QCD jet structure or if explicit Lund plane representations are complementary. Introduces PLuM, a multimodal architecture combining particle constituents and Lund plane splittings.

entry.title: Parsimonious Learning-Augmented Online Metric Matching

author.name: Yongho Shin, Phanu Vajanopath

entry.summary: Develops parsimonious learning-augmented algorithms for online metric matching and establishes lower bounds. Extends Follow-the-Prediction framework with virtual predictions when actual predictions are unavailable.

entry.title: BhashaSetu: A Data-Centric Approach to Low-Resource Machine Translation

author.name: Param Thakkar, Anushka Yadav, Michael Tiemann, Abhi Mehta, Akshita Bhasin, Shrinivas Khedkar

entry.summary: Presents BhashaSetu, a 2.78M sentence pair English-Marathi parallel corpus across diverse domains with stemmed and lemmatized representations. Benchmarks SOTA translation models and conducts LoRA fine-tuning of NLLB-200-distilled-600M.

entry.title: Is an Image Also Worth 16x16=256 Superpixels? A Framework for Attentional Image Classification

author.name: Pedro Henrique da Costa Avelar, Anderson R. Tavares, Lu\'is C. Lamb

entry.summary: Proposes Superpixel Transformers (SPT) unifying superpixel-based classification with Vision Transformers, generalizing prior GAT-based superpixel methods. Explores arbitrary superpixel chunking strategies for image classification.

entry.title: DunbaaBERT: From Sacrifice to Semantics

author.name: Iffat Maab, Waleed Jamil, Raphael Schmitt

entry.summary: Introduces DunbaaBERT, a family of Urdu RoBERTa-base models with Byte-BPE vocabularies of 32k, 52k, and 96k trained on 17GB deduplicated corpus. Evaluates vocabulary-size effects on Urdu NLP benchmarks.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Object Re-Identification in Egocentric Kitchen Videos via Multi-Stage SAM3 Feature Fusion

author.name: Dmytro Klepachevskyi, Alexander Wong, Sirisha Rambhatla, Yuhao Chen

entry.summary: Multi-stage SAM3 feature fusion approach for zero-shot object re-identification in egocentric kitchen videos on EPIC-Kitchens. Evaluates major pretrained extractors including CLIP, DINOv2, and I-JEPA showing zero-shot methods struggle on this task.

entry.title: Underwater360: Reconstructing Underwater Scenes from Panoramic Images with Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jiangbei Hu, Weichao Song, Shibo Yu, Mohan Wang, Zihan Yi, Rui Wu, Mingkang Xiang, Na Lei, Shengfa Wang, Zhongxuan Luo, Ying He

entry.summary: Underwater360 is a physics-informed omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting framework for underwater panoramic reconstruction that handles spherical projection distortion and medium degradation effects like scattering and absorption.

entry.title: Re-M3Dr: Rebalanced MultiModal Mean Deviation Regression

author.name: Haojie Yin, Chengcheng Feng, Tianyi Liu, Tianqi Zhang, Kaizhu Huang

entry.summary: Re-M3Dr addresses the surprising finding that multimodal OCT+fundus fusion underperforms unimodal models for visual field mean deviation prediction due to data-distribution imbalance. Proposes rebalanced training to fix the issue.

entry.title: Joint 2D-3D Segmentation and Association in Street-level Imaging

author.name: Amir Melnikov, Masayuki Tanaka, Yusuke Monno, Masatoshi Okutomi

entry.summary: Joint 2D-3D segmentation and association framework for street-level imagery using zero-shot detection, structure-from-motion, and 3D-driven correspondence for spatial digital twins. Replaces 2D tracking with geometric consistency.

entry.title: Learning Reference-Guided Exposure Correction with Hybrid Illumination Characteristics

author.name: Hao Ren, Zetong Bi, Zhaoliang Wan, Hui Cheng

entry.summary: HICNet performs reference-guided exposure correction using compact illumination embeddings driving multi-scale FiLM-based modulation, trained without ground truth via cross-batch contrastive loss. Addresses diverse lighting conditions.

entry.title: Gemini Embedding 2: A Native Multimodal Embedding Model from Gemini

author.name: Madhuri Shanbhogue, Zhe Li, Shanfeng Zhang, Gustavo Hern\'andez \'Abrego, Shih-Cheng Huang, Aashi Jain, Daniel Salz, Sonam Goenka, Chaitra Hegde, Ji Ma, Feiyang Chen, Jiaxing Wu, Tanmaya Dabral, Babak Samari, Kevin Poulet, Daniel Cer, Kaifeng Chen, Paul Suganathan, Hui Hui, Jovan Andonov, Philippe Schlattner, Jay Han, Iftekhar Naim, Wing Lowe, Vladimir Pchelin, Albert Yang, Yi-Ting Chen, Zhongli Ding, Grace Zhang, Georg Heigold, Yichang Chen, Antoine Reveillon, Brendan Mccloskey, Wenlei Zhou, Dahun Kim, Rui Meng, Emma Wang, Jack Zheng, Halley Fede, Zhen Yang, Keegan Mosley, Brian Potetz, Sahil Dua, Henrique Schechter Vera, Shen Gao, Hesen Zhang, Andreas Hess, Hengxuan Ying, Alberto Montes, Karan Gill, Min Choi, Sebastian Russo, Anja Hauth, Jinhyuk Lee, Michael Boratko, Megan Barnes, Vikram Rao, Claudiu Musat, Cyril Allauzen, Ehsan Variani, Shankar Kumar, Tom Bagby, Junyi Jiao, Yang Gu, Tengxin Li, Ayush Agrawal, Roberto Santana, Dev Nath, Stephen Karukas, Shuoxuan Han, Lucia Loher, Alice Twu, Nidhi Vyas, Siddharth Bhai, Frank Palma Gomez, Wangyuan Zhang, Chaoren Liu, Jizheng Yang, Steve Qiu, Shijie Zhang, Sujay Kulkarni, Sascha Rothe, Sean Nakamoto, Raphael Hoffmann, Zach Gleicher, Yunhsuan Sung, Qin Yin, Tom Duerig, Mojtaba Seyedhosseini

entry.summary: Google introduces Gemini Embedding 2, a unified multimodal embedding model covering video, audio, image, and text in a shared representation space, trained via large-scale multi-task contrastive learning. Reports SOTA across unimodal, cross-modal, and multimodal retrieval benchmarks.

entry.title: From Norms to Indicators (N2I-RAG): An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Legal Indicator Computation

author.name: Youssef Al Mouatamid, Marie Bonnin, Jihad Zahir

entry.summary: N2I-RAG is an agentic retrieval-augmented framework for computing legal indicators from normative texts with transparent, traceable evidence grounding for legal monitoring and policy evaluation.

entry.title: Maat: The Agentic Legal Research Assistant for Competition Protection

author.name: Basant Mounir, Farida Madkour, Amira Abdelaziz, Asmaa Sami

entry.summary: Maat is a ReAct agent for competition law research that orchestrates domain-specific tools designed iteratively with legal experts, grounding cases in official sources to avoid hallucinations common in general LLMs.

entry.title: When Does Adaptive Guidance Help? Belief-Aware Privileged Distillation for Autonomous Driving Under Partial Observability

author.name: Mehmet Haklidir

entry.summary: Belief-Aware GSAC modulates the distillation coefficient in privileged teacher-student RL using ensemble disagreement as an uncertainty signal for autonomous driving under partial observability. Empirical study finds mixed benefits depending on occlusion severity.

entry.title: Intelligent Detection and Mitigation of Carpet-Bombing DDoS Attacks in SDN Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Models

author.name: Mohammed N. Swileh, Shengli Zhang, Kai Lei

entry.summary: RAG-based framework for real-time detection and mitigation of Carpet-Bombing DDoS attacks in SDN, combining traffic feature embeddings, FAISS similarity retrieval, and LLM-driven contextual inference. Targets distributed traffic patterns that evade conventional detection.

entry.title: Plans for Evaluating Structured Generative Search Summaries

author.name: Tetsuya Sakai, Jina Lee, Hanpei Fang, Young-In Song

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for evaluating structured generative search summaries (overview, sections, citations) placed atop organic web search results, with plans for implementation and evaluation. From Tetsuya Sakai at Waseda.

entry.title: Certified Causal Attribution for Real-Time Attack Forensics in 6G Network Slicing

author.name: Minh K. Quan, Pubudu N. Pathirana

entry.summary: DA-GC framework for cross-slice attack attribution in 6G networks using resource-conditioned Granger causality and an axiomatic Resource Contention Model. Achieves sub-100ms attribution at 89% accuracy.

entry.title: Adversarial Training for Robust Coverage Network under Worst-case Facility Losses

author.name: Changhao Miao, Yuntian Zhang, Tongyu Wu, Fang Deng, Chen Chen

entry.summary: Dual-agent deep RL framework for resilient facility location under adversarial interdiction. Combines location and interdiction agents for the bi-level Maximal Covering Location-Interdiction Problem.

entry.title: Persistent AI Agents in Academic Research: A Single-Investigator Implementation Case Study

author.name: Anas H. Alzahrani

entry.summary: Single-investigator self-observation case study of persistent AI agents embedded in academic research over four months. Introduces PARE-M measurement framework for human-agent research environments.

entry.title: ReasonOps: A Unified Operational Paradigm for Trustworthy Verified LLM Reasoning

author.name: Adnan Rashid

entry.summary: ReasonOps proposes a unified operational paradigm for trustworthy LLM reasoning combining theorem proving, autoformalization, runtime assurance, and neuro-symbolic methods. Position-style framework paper.

entry.title: Deep-layer limit and stability analysis of the basic forward-backward-splitting induced network (II): learning problems

author.name: Xuan Lin, Chunlin Wu

entry.summary: Theoretical analysis of forward-backward-splitting-induced deep unfolding networks, establishing learning-problem properties under mild assumptions. Continues a series on convergence and stability of optimization-derived architectures.

entry.title: Generative Animations: A Multi-Model Pipeline for Prompt-Driven Motion Synthesis

author.name: Mannat Khurana, Sanyam Jain, Rishav Agarwal

entry.summary: A pipeline combining LLM semantic parsing with SAM visual grounding to convert natural language prompts into production-ready animation motion paths respecting scene geometry and 3D perspective. Targets contour-following, orbital, and perspective animations.

entry.title: TWIST: Closed-Loop token Synchronization for Application-Aware Wireless Digital Twins

author.name: Sige Liu, Kezhi Wang

entry.summary: TWIST is a closed-loop token synchronization framework for wireless digital twins, transmitting task-relevant tokens with mode-conditioned unequal error protection rather than pixel-level reconstruction. Aims to optimize semantic state for downstream applications.

entry.title: PATE-TabTransGAN: Differentially Private Synthetic Tabular Data Generation via Transformer-Based Student Discrimination

author.name: M. Youssef, M. Wo\'zniak

entry.summary: Combines PATE with a Transformer-based student discriminator in a GAN framework for differentially private tabular data synthesis, using GNMax RDP accounting. Aims to balance formal privacy guarantees with modeling inter-feature dependencies.

entry.title: SQARL: A Size-Agnostic Reinforcement Learning approach for Circuit Allocation in Distributed Quantum Architectures

author.name: V\'ictor Carballo, J\'ulia L\'opez-Closa, Mario Martin

entry.summary: Proposes SQARL, a size-agnostic deep RL approach for the qubit allocation problem in distributed quantum computing. Aims for flexibility to quantum hardware topology and improved performance over heuristics.

entry.title: Transfer Learning using 66 Diseases for Disease Forecasting Applications

author.name: Lauren J Beesley, Alexander C Murph, Dave Osthus, Lauren A Castro

entry.summary: Investigates transfer learning across 66 infectious diseases and multiple data streams for disease forecasting, showing that incorporating multiple data streams improves performance. Addresses the brittleness of single-stream forecasting models.

entry.title: Normal Guidance is what Attention Needs

author.name: Ethan Harvey, Dennis Johan Loevlie, Michael C. Hughes

entry.summary: Proposes Normal Guidance, a regularization technique for attention-based MIL in 3D medical image classification with only volume-level labels. Shows that center-focused baselines outperform existing MIL on multiple CT modalities.

entry.title: PILOT: A Data-Free Continual Learning Approach for Real-Time Semantic Segmentation via Boundary Guidance

author.name: Yujing Zhou, Prashant Shekhar, Thomas Yang, Yongxin Liu

entry.summary: PILOT proposes a data-free continual learning framework for PIDNet real-time semantic segmentation using boundary guidance to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Targets practical deployment in dynamic environments without requiring stored prior data.

entry.title: A multifractal-based masked auto-encoder: an application to medical images

author.name: Joao Batista Florindo, Viviane de Moura

entry.summary: MO-MAE replaces random masking in masked autoencoders with multifractal-Renyi-entropy-guided masking that focuses on high-complexity regions in medical images. Aims to improve learning of diagnostically relevant features.

entry.title: Joint Instance Segmentation and Geometric Attribute Regression for Roof Structures in Aerial Imagery

author.name: Luuk Versteeg, Rob G. J. Wijnhoven, Martin R. Oswald

entry.summary: Extends Mask R-CNN with attribute regression for joint roof segmentation and prediction of height, slope, and azimuth from aerial orthophotos using a DINOv3-based backbone trained on Dutch 3DBAG data. Addresses skewed distributions with normalized representations.

entry.title: NeR-SC: Adapting Neural Video Representation to Screen Content

author.name: Ruohan Shi, Jiaoyan Zhao, Haogang Feng

entry.summary: NeR-SC adapts implicit neural video representation to screen content video with a learnable color palette, edge-aware modules, and temporal redundancy exploitation. Targets remote desktop and cloud gaming compression scenarios.

entry.title: SCKAN: Structural Consensus-based KAN Prototype Learning for Semi-Supervised Pancreas Segmentation

author.name: Yuqi Liu, Yufei Chen, Wei Fu, Xiaodong Yue, Shuo Li

entry.summary: SCKAN introduces structural consensus learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for semi-supervised pancreas segmentation, addressing supervision bias from inter-sample morphological variability via prototype consistency.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Gaze Estimation via Disentangled Subspace Contrastive Learning

author.name: Qida Tan, Hongyu Yang, Wenchao Du

entry.summary: Semi-supervised gaze estimation using Jacobian regularization to disentangle features into pitch/yaw subspaces with contrastive learning. Reduces reliance on labor-intensive annotations.

entry.title: Design First, Code Later: Aesthetically Pleasing Template-Free Slides Generation

author.name: Zhiyao Cui, Chenxu Wang, Shuyue Hu, Yiqun Zhang, Wenqi Shao, Qiaosheng Zhang, Zhen Wang

entry.summary: DeepSlides is a hierarchical workflow for template-free presentation slide generation that decouples page-level design from code implementation. Introduces SlideDesign, an aesthetic design step before executable rendering.

entry.title: Unsupervised Deep Image Prior for Sparse-View and Limited-Angle Electron Tomography

author.name: Serge Brosset, Daniel del Pozo Bueno, Thomas David, Laure Guetaz, Philippe Ciuciu, Zineb Saghi

entry.summary: Applies unsupervised Deep Image Prior to electron tomography under sparse-view and limited-angle conditions, achieving quality comparable to supervised methods without training data. Demonstrates on simulated and experimental nanomaterials data.

entry.title: Collaborative Navigation and Exploration with $\beta$-Sparse Gaussian Processes

author.name: Evangelos Psomiadis, Dipankar Maity, Panagiotis Tsiotras

entry.summary: Introduces beta-Sparse Gaussian Processes, a variational sparse GP for task-aware inducing point selection in collaborative multi-robot navigation under bandwidth constraints. Used to predict unexplored regions and select transmitted map points.

entry.title: RCSP: Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning for Safe Dynamic Robot Navigation

author.name: Zhengye Han, Quanyan Zhu

entry.summary: RCSP is a planning layer that maintains beliefs over short-horizon obstacle motion conjectures, samples futures, and penalizes high-risk tails to avoid predictive near-miss commitments. Tested in MuJoCo bottleneck tasks.

entry.title: Heterogeneous AAV Logistics Task Allocation: A Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Overlapping Coalition Formation Game Approach

author.name: Yuze Zhou, Jingliang Sun, Junzhi Li, Jianxin Zhong, Zihan Wang, Teng Long

entry.summary: Combines reinforcement learning with overlapping coalition formation games for heterogeneous AAV logistics task allocation under stochastic order arrivals. Uses transformer-based soft actor-critic to encode variable-length task states.

entry.title: Manipulating Tangible Virtual Object Dynamics to Promote Learning of Precision Force Generation

author.name: Alberto Garz\'as-Villar, Alba Riera-Cardona, Alexis Derumigny, J. Micah Prendergast, Jane Murray Cramm, Laura Marchal-Crespo

entry.summary: Studies how manipulating virtual object dynamics in haptic VR can train precise force generation, relevant to post-stroke rehabilitation. Curling-inspired task with linear and Gaussian spring models tested on 50 healthy participants.

entry.title: Learning Compositional Symbolic Task Rules from Demonstrations with Inductive Logic Programming

author.name: Oleh Borys, Karla Stepanova

entry.title: Research Summary: May 26, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by safety, alignment, and interpretability work, with several substantive contributions from Anthropic. Constitution-following audits of frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI reveal specification gaps under multi-turn adversarial pressure. Faithfulness as Information Flow introduces sufficiency/completeness/necessity properties for CoT monitoring, while a complementary meta-evaluation shows existing faithfulness metrics fail to measure what they purport to measure.

  • Polymorphism Is Rotation: independently trained transformers compute the same function in residual-stream bases that differ only by a uniform random rotation, with strong implications for cross-model SAE transfer and circuit universality
  • From Simulation to Enaction (Jack Lindsey, Anthropic): post-trained LLMs implicitly recognize their own generations with 3-4x lower entropy than off-policy text, across families and scales
  • Cognitive Security as an AI Safety Cause Area (Steinhardt): position paper framing belief/action autonomy as a major emerging safety frontier

Real-world impact and agent capabilities round out the highlights. A 45,000-researcher global RCT delivered LLM feedback on 31,000+ arXiv preprints, providing rare causal evidence on AI's effect on scientific output. QUEST releases an open family of 2B-35B deep research agents with a full mid-training/SFT/RL recipe focused on citation grounding. HumanEgo achieves zero-shot human-to-robot transfer from minutes of egocentric video via entity-level hand-object representations, and self-generated replay is shown to nearly eliminate catastrophic forgetting when model capacity is unsaturated.
entry.content:
Today's research is dominated by safety, alignment, and interpretability work, with several substantive contributions from Anthropic. Constitution-following audits of frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI reveal specification gaps under multi-turn adversarial pressure. Faithfulness as Information Flow introduces sufficiency/completeness/necessity properties for CoT monitoring, while a complementary meta-evaluation shows existing faithfulness metrics fail to measure what they purport to measure.

  • Polymorphism Is Rotation: independently trained transformers compute the same function in residual-stream bases that differ only by a uniform random rotation, with strong implications for cross-model SAE transfer and circuit universality
  • From Simulation to Enaction (Jack Lindsey, Anthropic): post-trained LLMs implicitly recognize their own generations with 3-4x lower entropy than off-policy text, across families and scales
  • Cognitive Security as an AI Safety Cause Area (Steinhardt): position paper framing belief/action autonomy as a major emerging safety frontier

Real-world impact and agent capabilities round out the highlights. A 45,000-researcher global RCT delivered LLM feedback on 31,000+ arXiv preprints, providing rare causal evidence on AI's effect on scientific output. QUEST releases an open family of 2B-35B deep research agents with a full mid-training/SFT/RL recipe focused on citation grounding. HumanEgo achieves zero-shot human-to-robot transfer from minutes of egocentric video via entity-level hand-object representations, and self-generated replay is shown to nearly eliminate catastrophic forgetting when model capacity is unsaturated.

entry.title: How Well Do Models Follow Their Constitutions?

author.name: Arya Jakkli, Senthooran Rajamanoharan, Neel Nanda

entry.summary: Audits how well frontier models follow their own published constitutions (Anthropic, OpenAI) under multi-turn adversarial pressure, decomposing specifications into 200+ atomic tenets each. Work from Neel Nanda group.

entry.title: Human-AI Collaboration in Science at Scale: A Global Large-scale Randomized Field Experiment

author.name: Binglu Wang, Weixin Liang, Jiahui Xue, Yuhui Zhang, Hancheng Cao, Dashun Wang, Yian Yin

entry.summary: Large-scale randomized field experiment delivering LLM-generated feedback on 31,000+ arXiv preprints to 45,000+ researchers globally. Shows feedback recipients revised manuscripts 12.55% more than controls.

entry.title: Polymorphism Is Rotation: Operational Mechanistic Interpretability from a Two-Layer Transformer to Pythia-70m

author.name: Jordan F. McCann

entry.summary: Demonstrates polymorphism: independently trained transformers compute the same function in residual-stream bases that differ by a uniform random rotation. A single matrix multiplication enables transfer of SAE features and steering vectors between models.

entry.title: HumanEgo: Zero-Shot Robot Learning from Minutes of Human Egocentric Videos

author.name: Zhi (Leo), Wang, Botao He, Kelin Yu, Seungjae Lee, Ruohan Gao, Furong Huang, Yiannis Aloimonos

entry.summary: HumanEgo bridges human-to-robot embodiment gap by lifting egocentric video to entity-level hand-object representations, training a flow matching policy with auxiliary objectives. Reports 92.5% success on real tasks from 30 minutes of human video, no robot data.

entry.title: From Simulation to Enaction: Post-trained language models recognize and react to their own generations

author.name: Asvin G., Jack Lindsey

entry.summary: Shows post-trained LLMs implicitly recognize their own on-policy generations with 3-4x lower entropy than off-policy text across families and sizes. Traces effect to internal representation of input surprise.

entry.title: Faithfulness as Information Flow: Evaluating and Training Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

author.name: Jinghan Jia, Joe Benton, Eric Easley

entry.summary: Studies CoT faithfulness via information flow framework with sufficiency/completeness/necessity properties. From Anthropic (Joe Benton).

entry.title: Forgetting in Language Models: Capacity, Optimization, and Self-Generated Replay

author.name: Martin Marek, Dongkyu Cho, Shikai Qiu, Rumi Chunara, Pavel Izmailov, Andrew Gordon Wilson

entry.summary: Studies catastrophic forgetting in language models and shows that self-generated replay samples nearly eliminate forgetting when model capacity is not saturated. Identifies the interaction between capacity, learning rate, and forgetting from credible authors (Wilson, Izmailov).

entry.title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks

author.name: Jian Xie, Tianhe Lin, Zilu Wang, Yuting Ning, Yuekun Yao, Tianci Xue, Zhehao Zhang, Zhongyang Li, Kai Zhang, Yufan Wu, Shijie Chen, Boyu Gou, Mingzhe Han, Yifei Wang, Vint Lee, Xinpeng Wei, Xiangjun Wang, Yu Su, Huan Sun

entry.summary: QUEST is a family of open 2B-35B deep research agents trained with a mid-training, SFT, RL recipe focused on fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Aims to match frontier proprietary deep research systems with broad generalization.

entry.title: Faithfulness Metrics Don't Measure Faithfulness: A Meta-Evaluation with Ground Truth

author.name: Yoav Gur-Arieh, Ana Marasovi\'c, Mor Geva

entry.summary: Critical meta-evaluation showing that existing faithfulness metrics for chain-of-thought reasoning do not actually measure faithfulness, since they rely on proxies like plausibility rather than ground-truth labels of internal computations.

entry.title: Cognitive Security as an AI Safety Cause Area

author.name: jsteinhardt

entry.summary: Jacob Steinhardt argues cognitive security (humans maintaining control over beliefs/actions) should be a major AI safety cause area, citing evidence of AI persuasion, AI psychosis, deepfakes, and impersonation scams already occurring.

entry.title: Inference Time Context Sparsity: Illusion or Opportunity?

author.name: Sahil Joshi, Prithvi Dixit, Agniva Chowdhury, Anshumali Shrivastava, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Ion Stoica, Kumar Krishna Agrawal, Aditya Desai

entry.summary: Position paper arguing for principled extreme context-dimension sparsity in LLM inference, claiming dense attention constraints are artificial. From a strong author lineup including Stoica and Gonzalez.

entry.title: A governance horizon for ethical-use constraints in open-weight AI models

author.name: Weiwei Xu, Hengzhi Ye, Haoran Ye, Kai Gao, Vladimir Filkov, Minghui Zhou

entry.summary: Audits 2.1M HuggingFace model repos to find ethical-use restriction evidence decays with a half-life of 1.31 derivation steps, formalizing a governance horizon beyond which traceability is lost. Important empirical AI governance finding.

entry.title: Understanding and Mitigating Premature Confidence for Better LLM Reasoning

author.name: Jingchu Gai, Guanning Zeng, Christina Baek, Chen Wu, J. Zico Kolter, Andrej Risteski, Aditi Raghunathan

entry.summary: Identifies premature confidence (committing to an answer early then rationalizing) as a predictor of flawed CoT reasoning, and proposes progressive confidence shaping RL to mitigate it. Strong author lineup (Kolter, Risteski, Raghunathan).

entry.title: Language Models Need Sleep

author.name: Sangyun Lee, Sean McLeish, Tom Goldstein, Giulia Fanti

entry.summary: Proposes sleep-like consolidation mechanism converting recent context into persistent fast weights in SSM blocks, clearing KV cache. Shifts extra computation to sleep while preserving wake-time latency.

entry.title: ECHO: Terminal Agents Learn World Models for Free

author.name: Vaishnavi Shrivastava, Piero Kauffmann, Ahmed Awadallah, Dimitris Papailiopoulos

entry.summary: ECHO uses terminal output as auxiliary world-model supervision in CLI agent training. Combines policy gradient on actions with cross-entropy loss on environment responses. From Microsoft/Awadallah group.

entry.title: Stop Comparing LLM Agents Without Disclosing the Harness

author.name: Yunbei Zhang, Janet Wang, Yingqiang Ge, Weijie Xu, Jihun Hamm, Chandan K. Reddy

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that the agent execution harness (orchestration, tool interaction, verification) often determines performance more than the underlying model. Calls for harness disclosure in agent benchmarks.

entry.title: Toward Enactive Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Banafsheh Rafiee, Richard Sutton

entry.summary: Sutton and Rafiee advocate incorporating enactive perception (action-shaped experience) into AI, contrasting with passive sensory-processing views. Develops four enactive concepts relevant to AI design.

entry.title: A Signal-Language Foundation Model for Broad-Spectrum Cardiovascular Assessment from Routine Electrocardiography

author.name: Ziqing Yu, Yuhui Tao, Jiayu Huo, Lei Pan, Zilong Xiao, Juecheng Chen, Xiao Li, Jianxuan Li, You Zhou, Zhixing Li, Cong Wang, Beijian Zhang, Chen Chen, Hongyang Lu, Konstantinos Patlatzoglou, Daniel B. Kramer, Jonathan W. Waks, Yangang Su, Fu Siong Ng, Shuo Wang, Yixiu Liang, Junbo Ge

entry.summary: ECGCLIP is a signal-language contrastive learning foundation model aligning ECG waveforms with diagnostic reports, pre-trained on 2.8M studies from 1.3M patients and evaluated on 89 downstream tasks across 9 cohorts with ~1.5M ECGs.

entry.title: Retrying vs Resampling in AI Control

author.name: James Lucassen, Adam Kaufman

entry.summary: Compares retrying versus resampling strategies in AI control scaffolds for coding agents, treating models as potentially adversarial. Finds resampling avoids the leakage of monitor information that retrying suffers from, with experiments using Claude Opus 4.6.

entry.title: AI in the Enterprise: How People Use M365 Copilot Chat

author.name: Scott Counts, Yan Chen, Jing Dong, Himanshu Sharma, Andrey Zaikin, Rui Hu, Alperen Kok, Gorkem Ozer Yilmaz, Siddharth Suri, Kiran Tomlinson, Sonia Jaffe, Will Wang

entry.summary: Microsoft analysis of how people use M365 Copilot Chat across millions of weekly users, based on 5.5 million sessions. Classifies user intent and O*NET work activities, characterizing Copilot as an emerging everyday work assistant.

entry.title: The Time is Here for Just-in-Time Systems: Challenges and Opportunities

author.name: Shu Liu, Alexander Krentsel, Shubham Agarwal, Mert Cemri, Ziming Mao, Soujanya Ponnapalli, Alexandros G. Dimakis, Sylvia Ratnasamy, Matei Zaharia, Aditya Parameswaran, Ion Stoica

entry.summary: Argues LLM coding agents enable Just-in-Time Systems synthesized from scratch and specialized to each environment. Presents Jitskit pipeline synthesizing key-value stores from spec cards across YCSB workloads.

entry.title: Continuous-Depth Field Theory for Transformer Patching and Mechanistic Interpretability

author.name: David N. Olivieri, Antonio F. P\'erez Rodr\'iguez

entry.summary: Statistical theory and semi-supervised framework for multi-objective learning in diffusion models, with sample-complexity guarantees that reconcile generalist capacity needs with limited per-task data. Theoretical contribution from a strong author group including Abbeel and Malik.

entry.title: JudgmentBench: Comparing Rubric and Preference Evaluation for Quality Assessment

author.name: Russell Yang, Ruishi Chen, Pierce Kelaita, Riya Ranjan, Sibo Ma, Charles Dickens, Matthew Guillod, Megan Ma, Julian Nyarko

entry.summary: JudgmentBench releases 30 real-world legal tasks with both rubric scores and pairwise preference judgments from practicing attorneys to compare evaluation methodologies. Valuable expert-annotated benchmark for LLM judging.

entry.title: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Perry Dong, Kuo-Han Hung, Tian Gao, Dorsa Sadigh, Chelsea Finn

entry.summary: EXPO-FT enables sample-efficient RL fine-tuning of pretrained VLA models, building on stable extrapolation from pretrained priors. From Chelsea Finn and Dorsa Sadigh groups at Stanford.

entry.title: Explaining Too Much? Understanding How Large Language Model Reasoning Traces Influence Performance and Metacognition

author.name: Daniela Fernandes, Daniel Buschek, Lev Tankelevitch, Thomas Kosch, Robin Welsch

entry.summary: Preregistered study with 559 participants comparing answer-only, full-trace, and summary-trace LLM interfaces on LSAT reasoning problems. Finds summaries elevate trust without performance benefits, raising verbosity concerns.

entry.title: Towards Verifiable Transformers: Solver-Checkable Circuit Explanations

author.name: Neel Somani

entry.summary: Verifiable Transformers framework converts task-localized circuits into bounded SMT-solver-checkable claims (projected equivalence, edge necessity, robustness). Bridges interpretability and formal verification.

entry.title: Directional Alignment Mitigates Reward Hacking in Reinforcement Learning for Language Models

author.name: Wenlong Deng, Jiaji Huang, Kaan Ozkara, Yushu Li, Christos Thrampoulidis, Xiaoxiao Li, Youngsuk Park

entry.summary: Analyzes reward hacking in language model RL through the geometry of parameter updates, showing hacking runs exhibit larger directional drift in dominant singular directions. Introduces trusted-direction projection to constrain gradients to a clean reference subspace.

entry.title: Spiking the training data to correct for test set contamination

author.name: Johnny Tian-Zheng Wei, Jerry Li, Ameya Godbole, Robin Jia

entry.summary: Proposes spiking training data with intentionally contaminated test examples at known rates to calibrate memorization predictors and statistically correct inflated test scores. Uses Hubble model pairs for evaluation.

entry.title: Memory-Induced Tool-Drift in LLM Agents

author.name: Mahavir Dabas, Jihyun Jeong, Ming Jin, Ruoxi Jia

entry.summary: MEMDRIFT benchmark documents memory-induced tool-drift in LLM agents where personality biases stored in memory silently alter tool calls in contexts where they should not apply. 105 scenarios across 5 bias dimensions and 7 domains, tested on 7 frontier models including reasoning models.

entry.title: Algorithms with Polynomially-Improved Approximation Factors for the $2 \rightarrow q$ Norm, and Applications

author.name: Samuel B. Hopkins, Stefan Tiegel

entry.summary: Polynomial-time approximation algorithms for the 2-to-q matrix norm in the hypercontractive regime, with consequences for Small Set Expansion, Best Separable State, and algorithmic statistics. Improves long-standing approximation factors.

entry.title: ERNIE-Image Technical Report

author.name: Jiaxiang Liu, Zhida Feng, Pengyu Zou, Zhenyu Qian, Tianrui Zhu, Jun Xia, Yuehu Dong, Yanzheng Lin, Honglin Xiong, Anqi Chen, Yunpeng Ding, Jinghui Duan, Lin Gao, Chao Han, Tiechao He, Jiakang Hu, Ranjun Hua, Xueming Jiang, Qingli Kong, Yuting Lei, Tianyu Li, Yunlin Liu, Changling Liu, Yaxin Liu, Yi Liu, Xuguang Liu, Xiaolong Ma, Yan Pan, Yiran Ren, Nan Sheng, Yu Sun, Siyang Sun, Yixiang Tu, Yang Wan, Huanai Wang, Siqi Wang, Yang Wu, Youzhi Yang, Xiaowen Yang, Jianwen Yang, Yehua Yang, Quanwen Zhang, Xinmin Zhang, Haoxin Zhang, Xiang Zhang, Jun Zhang, Qian Zhang, Qiao Zhao, Qi Zhou

entry.summary: ERNIE-Image is Baidu's open-source 8B single-stream DiT text-to-image model, using bottom-up data construction with fine-grained categorization, caption annotation, and aesthetic assessment in pretraining plus top-down post-training. Aims to close the open vs. closed source gap.

entry.title: PAC Learning with Bandit Feedback: Sharp Sample Complexity in the Realizable Setting

author.name: Steve Hanneke, Qinglin Meng, Shay Moran, Amirreza Shaeiri

entry.summary: Provides sharp sample complexity characterization for multiclass PAC learning with bandit feedback in the realizable setting, matching for every concept class up to log factors. Closes a long-standing gap in bandit PAC theory.

entry.title: Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation

author.name: Ali Rouzbayani, Bidhan Roy, Marcos Villagra, Zhiying Jiang

entry.summary: Paris 2.0 is the first decentrally pretrained video generation model, extending the prior decentralized diffusion image model to temporally coherent video. Achieves ~2x FVD improvement over a monolithic model under matched compute budget.

entry.title: DiscoverPhysics: Benchmarking LLMs for Out-of-the-Box Scientific Thinking

author.name: Matt L. Wiemann, Lindsay M. Smith, Peter Melchior, Siddharth Mishra-Sharma, Andrew Gordon Wilson, Pavel Izmailov, Carolina Cuesta-L\'azaro

entry.summary: DiscoverPhysics is an interactive benchmark with 22 simulated worlds having physics deliberately deviating from our own, asking LLM agents to discover laws of motion via experimentation. Tests genuine scientific reasoning vs. recall by including screened gravity, hidden particles, and time-varying interactions.

entry.title: Automated Benchmark Auditing for AI Agents and Large Language Models

author.name: Junlin Wang, Federico Bianchi, Shang Zhu, Fan Nie, Yongchan Kwon, Bhuwan Dhingra, James Zou

entry.summary: Auto Benchmark Audit is an agentic framework that systematically audits 168 benchmarks across nine domains (frontier LLM benchmarks plus NeurIPS papers) finding ambiguous task design, execution conflicts, and limited grading logic.

entry.title: Seeing without Looking: Do Vision-Language Benchmarks Really Test Vision?

author.name: Zixuan Lan, Luzhe Sun, Matthew R. Walter, Jiawei Zhou

entry.summary: Investigates whether vision-language benchmark scores actually reflect grounded visual understanding, finding that removing many image tokens minimally degrades performance on hallucination benchmarks. Systematically analyzes the visual evidence reliance of open-source VLMs.

entry.title: When Correct Beliefs Collapse: Epistemic Resilience of LLMs under Clinical Pressure

author.name: Boyu Xiao, Xiuqi Tian, Xuwen Song, Haochun Wang, Guanchun Song, Sendong Zhao, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Med-Stress evaluates multi-turn sycophancy in nine frontier LLMs during clinical dialogue, showing high medical knowledge does not imply belief stability. Proposes RBED, a lightweight inference-time defense.

entry.title: Credit Assignment with Resets in Language Model Reasoning

author.name: Ankur Samanta, Akshayaa Magesh, Ayush Jain, Youliang Yu, Daniel Jiang, Kavosh Asadi, Daniel Jiang, Kaveh Hassani, Paul Sajda, Jalaj Bhandari, Yonathan Efroni

entry.summary: Proposes Random-Reset Policy Optimization to improve credit assignment in LLM RL reasoning by resetting to intermediate states and resampling counterfactual continuations, enabling targeted refinement of faulty steps rather than uniform trajectory updates.

entry.title: ScaleAcross Explorer: Exploring Communication Optimization for Scale-Across AI Model Training

author.name: Minghao Li, Alicia Golden, Samuel Hsia, Michael Kuchnik, Adi Gangidi, Xu Zhang, Ashmitha Jeevaraj Shetty, Zachary DeVito, Weiwei Chu, Dong He, Haoci Zhang, Yuchen Hao, Ruoming Pang, James Hongyi Zeng, Ying Zhang, Minlan Yu, Carole-Jean Wu

entry.summary: ScaleAcross Explorer characterizes communication optimization for scale-across LLM training across multiple data center buildings, drawing on Meta's production experience. Analyzes parallelism placement, parallelism order, and collective design.

entry.title: Causal Tongue-Tie: LLMs Can Encode Causal Direction, But Their Yes/No Outputs Fail to Express

author.name: Ziyi Ding, Xiao-Ping Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies a Causal Tongue-Tie effect where LLMs encode correct causal answers in hidden states (~97% probe accuracy) but verbalize commonsense wrong answers (~50%). Suggests output-only benchmarks misrepresent model understanding.

entry.title: Small Models, Strong Priors: Architectural Inductive Bias for Parameter-Efficient Neural PDE Solvers

author.name: Shyam Sankaran, Hanwen Wang, Paris Perdikaris

entry.summary: WaveLiT combines discrete wavelet transforms with linear attention for parameter-efficient neural PDE solving. 1-10M parameter models compete with foundation models 100-1000x larger.

entry.title: Fourier Feature Pyramids for Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Brandon Zhao, Yixuan Wang, Jonathan T. Barron, Katherine L. Bouman, Dor Verbin, Pratul P. Srinivasan

entry.summary: Beignet uses trainable multi-resolution Fourier feature pyramid for PINNs, replacing random Fourier features. From Caltech/Google group (Barron, Bouman, Srinivasan, Verbin).

entry.title: How Much Thinking is Enough? Quantifying and Understanding Redundancy in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhai, Xinkai You, Wenjing Yan, Xin Wang

entry.summary: The paper formalizes and measures redundancy in long chain-of-thought reasoning by quantifying how much trailing reasoning can be truncated while preserving correctness. It offers first-principles analysis of unnecessary deliberation in reasoning models.

entry.title: EvoCode-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Iterative Interactions

author.name: Haiyang Shen, Xuanzhong Chen, Wendong Xu, Yun Ma, Liang Chen, Kuan Li

entry.summary: EvoCode-Bench evaluates 13 coding agents across 26 stateful multi-round tasks with cumulative tests, finding most agents perform worse over 5-15 rounds than in single-round settings. Highlights state preservation challenges.

entry.title: Palette: A Modular, Controllable, and Efficient Framework for On-demand Authorized Safety Alignment Relaxation in LLMs

author.name: Qitao Tan, Xiaoying Song, Arman Akbari, Arash Akbari, Yanzhi Wang, Xiaoming Zhai, Lingzi Hong, Zhen Xiang, Jin Lu, Geng Yuan

entry.summary: Palette modularly relaxes refusal behavior on authorized professional domains while preserving general safety, using refusal direction identification via multi-objective steering. Addresses one-size-fits-all alignment limits.

entry.title: A Sober Look at Agentic Misalignment in Automated Workflows

author.name: Wenqian Ye, Bo Yuan, Zhichao Xu, Yijun Tian, Yawei Wang, Henry Kautz, Aidong Zhang

entry.summary: Studies agentic misalignment in multi-agent workflows where agents act on implicit proxy utilities misaligned with human goals, showing Bayesian posterior collapse. Proposes Agentic Evidence Attribution to correct misaligned behavior.

entry.title: Fundamental Limitation in Explaining AI

author.name: Atsushi Suzuki, Jing Wang

entry.summary: Mathematically proves a fundamental quadrilemma: AI systems and their explanations cannot simultaneously satisfy four conditions including complete faithfulness, interpretability, complexity, and operability. Has implications for AI governance.

entry.title: FrontierOR: Benchmarking LLMs' Capacity for Efficient Algorithm Design in Large-Scale Optimization

author.name: Minwei Kong, Chonghe Jiang, Ao Qu, Wenbin Ouyang, Zhaoming Zeng, Xiaotong Guo, Zhekai Li, Junyi Li, Yi Fan, Xinshou Zheng, Xi Jing, Yikai Zhang, Zhiwei Liang, Seonghoo Kim, Runqing Yang, Zijian Zhou, Sirui Li, Han Zheng, Wangyang Ying, Ou Zheng, Chonghuan Wang, Jinglong Zhao, Hanzhang Qin, Cathy Wu, Paul Pu Liang, Jinhua Zhao, Hai Wang

entry.summary: FrontierOR is a benchmark of 180 large-scale optimization tasks derived from top-tier OR venues, evaluating LLMs on designing efficient scalable algorithms rather than simple formulation-and-solve, with substantial author collaboration including MIT and CMU researchers.

entry.title: AI Cartography: Mapping the Latent Landscape of AI Benchmark Ecosystems

author.name: Michael Hardy, Anka Reuel, Lijin Zhang, Jodi M. Casabianca, Sang Truong, Yash Dave, Hansol Lee, Benjamin Domingue, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: Applies Confirmatory Factor Analysis and Generalizability Theory to 4000+ models from Open LLM Leaderboard to decompose ranking variance, finding underestimated benchmark correlations and local dependence undermining measurement validity.

entry.title: CUA-Gym: Scaling Verifiable Training Environments and Tasks for Computer-Use Agents

author.name: Bowen Wang, Dunjie Lu, Junli Wang, Tianyi Bai, Shixuan Liu, Zhipeng Zhang, Haiquan Wang, Hao Hu, Tianbao Xie, Shuai Bai, Dayiheng Liu, Que Shen, Junyang Lin, Tao Yu

entry.summary: CUA-Gym is a scalable pipeline co-generating task instructions, environment states, and reward functions for computer-use agent RL training with verifiable rewards, addressing data scarcity for CUAs. Authors include Alibaba/Qwen team.

entry.title: Explore Before You Solve: The Speed--Depth Trade-off in Epistemic Agents for ARC-AGI-3

author.name: Liew Keong Han

entry.summary: Critiques the public ARC-AGI-3 benchmark by showing all 25 public games are reachable via non-intelligent strategies including blind actions. Introduces AERA agent and argues only the private evaluation set genuinely tests intelligence.

entry.title: Check Your LLM's Secret Dictionary! Five Lines of Code Reveal What Your LLM Learned (Including What It Shouldn't Have)

author.name: Hisashi Miyashita
