entry.summary: Proposes Agentic Agile-V framework arguing that the central problem in AI coding is engineering process control, not prompt engineering. Synthesizes evidence from controlled studies showing heterogeneous productivity effects.

entry.title: EPC-3D-Diff: Equivariant Physics Consistent Conditional 3D Latent Diffusion for CBCT to CT Synthesis

author.name: Alzahra Altalib, Chunhui Li, Haytham Al Ewaidat, Khaled Alawneh, Ahmad Qendel, Alessandro Perelli

entry.summary: EPC-3D-Diff is a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework for CBCT-to-CT synthesis that enforces physics-consistent equivariance in the projection domain, exploiting the relationship between in-plane rotations and angular shifts in projections.

entry.title: Dynamic TMoE: A Drift-Aware Dynamic Mixture of Experts Framework for Non-Stationary Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jiawen Zhu, Shuhan Liu, Di Weng, Yingcai Wu

entry.summary: Dynamic TMoE uses MMD-based distribution shift detection to dynamically instantiate/prune heterogeneous experts and a temporal memory router for non-stationary time series forecasting.

entry.title: DIVE: Embedding Compression via Self-Limiting Gradient Updates

author.name: Dongfang Zhao

entry.summary: DIVE proposes embedding compression via self-limiting gradient updates, using a hinge-based triplet loss that produces zero gradient once margins are satisfied, addressing overfitting in existing compression adapters under data scarcity.

entry.title: SCRIBE: Diagnostic Evaluation and Rich Transcription Models for Indic ASR

author.name: Kavya Manohar, Arghya Bhattacharya, Kush Juvekar, Kumarmanas Nethil

entry.summary: SCRIBE is a diagnostic framework for Indic ASR providing categorical error decomposition (lexical, punctuation, numeral, domain-entity) through sandhi-tolerant alignment, addressing WER's failures for agglutinative languages.

entry.title: CAdam: Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation for 3D Gaussian Densification in Generative Distillation

author.name: SeungJeh Chung, Geonho Park, Misong Kim, HyeongYeop Kang

entry.summary: Introduces Context-Adaptive Moment Estimation (CAdam) for 3D Gaussian Splatting densification in generative distillation, treating densification as a statistical estimation problem to separate geometric signals from noise.

entry.title: Single-Pass, Depth-Selective Reading for Multi-Aspect Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yan Xia, Zhuangzhuang Pan, Amirrudin Kamsin, Chee Seng Chan

entry.summary: Proposes DABS, a single-pass inference framework for aspect-term sentiment analysis that encodes sentences once to construct a reusable depth-ordered substrate, which each aspect then queries selectively.

entry.title: SURGE: An Event-Centric Social Media Sentiment Time Series Benchmark with Interaction Structure

author.name: Chen Su, Pengsen Cheng, Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song

entry.summary: Introduces SURGE, a multi-event social media benchmark pairing event-level sentiment time series with text and interaction structure, enabling study of how social interactions shape collective dynamics.

entry.title: DeCoR: Design and Control Co-Optimization for Urban Streets Using Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bibek Poudel, Lei Zhu, Kevin Heaslip, Sai Swaminathan, Weizi Li

entry.summary: Introduces DeCoR, a two-stage RL framework co-optimizing crosswalk placement and signal control for urban streets using flow observations from video and WiFi sensing.

entry.title: TempGlitch: Evaluating Vision-Language Models for Temporal Glitch Detection in Gameplay Videos

author.name: Yakun Yu, Ashley Wiens, Adri\'an Barahona-R\'ios, Benedict Wilkins, Saman Zadtootaghaj, Nabajeet Barman, Cor-Paul Bezemer

entry.summary: Introduces TempGlitch, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on temporal glitch detection in gameplay videos. Shows that temporal glitches (only visible across ordered frames) are substantially harder for VLMs than spatial ones.

entry.title: AirfoilGen: A valid-by-construction and performance-aware latent diffusion model for airfoil generation

author.name: Zhijie Yang, Min Tang, Peng Du, Qiang Zou

entry.summary: Proposes AirfoilGen, a latent diffusion model for airfoil generation using a novel circle sweeping representation that guarantees geometric validity by construction while conditioning on aerodynamic performance.

entry.title: Can Conversational XAI Improve User Performance? An Experimental Study

author.name: Sven Kruschel, Julian Rosenberger, Lasse Bohlen, Mathias Kraus, Patrick Zschech

entry.summary: Proposes an experimental design for evaluating conversational XAI assistants through prediction accuracy, model understanding, and error identification. Compares conversational vs. Q&A-based assistance.

entry.title: ReversedQ: Opportunities for Faster Q-Learning in Episodic Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sofia R. Miskala-Dinc, Aviva Prins

entry.summary: Studies model-free Q-learning in finite-horizon episodic MDPs, identifying three opportunities for faster learning: value-function update order, update frequencies, and initialization. Shows empirical improvements.

entry.title: A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study in Power Quality Disturbance Classification

author.name: Yinsong Chen, Samson S. Yu, Zhong Li, Chee Peng Lim

entry.summary: Formalizes the explanation distribution from Bayesian neural networks as a push-forward measure and proposes uncertainty-aware relevance attribution operators (UA-RAO) that summarize explanation distributions for XAI.

entry.title: A New Framework to Analyse the Distributional Robustness of Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Divij Khaitan, Subhashis Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes a framework analyzing distributional robustness of DNNs by modeling interactions between layer weights and activations using Bernoulli distributions, using class separation as a diagnostic proxy.

entry.title: WildRoadBench: A Wild Aerial Road-Damage Grounding Benchmark for Vision-Language Models and Autonomous Agents

author.name: Bingnan Liu, Chenhang Cui, Rui Huang, Jiani Luo, Zhirong Shen, Tinghao Wang, Xiande Huang, Lingbei Meng, Fei Shen, An Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WildRoadBench, a benchmark for aerial road-damage detection that evaluates both VLM direct grounding and autonomous agent research capabilities on UAV imagery.

entry.title: Motion-Robust Deep Reconstruction for Free-Breathing Cardiac Cine MRI

author.name: Mahmut Yurt, Kanghyun Ryu, Zhitao Li, Xucheng Zhu, Xianglun Mao, Martin Janich, Marcus Alley, Kawin Setsompop, John Pauly, Shreyas Vasanawala, Ali Syed

entry.summary: Proposes Cine-DL for free-breathing cardiac cine MRI reconstruction combining k-space preprocessing with model-based deep learning for pediatric and non-compliant patients.

entry.title: Neural Negative Binomial Regression for Weekly Seismicity Forecasting: Per-Cell Dispersion Estimation and Tail Risk Assessment

author.name: Alim Igilik

entry.summary: Proposes EarthquakeNet, a neural architecture for weekly seismicity forecasting that estimates per-cell overdispersion parameters, strongly rejecting the standard Poisson assumption used in earthquake forecasting.

entry.title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora

author.name: Maciej Skorski

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM-based translation preserves moral semantics, using Polish as test case with 50k annotated social media posts. Validates through four methods that moral foundations survive machine translation, enabling cross-lingual moral analysis.

entry.title: AnyMo: Geometry-Aware Setup-Agnostic Modeling of Human Motion in the Wild

author.name: Baiyu Chen, Zechen Li, Wilson Wongso, Lihuan Li, Xiachong Lin, Hao Xue, Benjamin Tag, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Introduces AnyMo, a geometry-aware framework for setup-agnostic human motion modeling from wearable IMUs. Uses physics-grounded simulation over body-surface placements for setup-independent motion representations.

entry.title: AVI-HT: Adaptive Vision-IMU Fusion for 3D Hand Tracking

author.name: Ziyi Kou, Ankit Kumar, Mia Huang, Taylor Niehues, Vatsal Mehta, Ergys Ristani, Li Guan

entry.summary: Presents AVI-HT for adaptive visual-IMU fusion in 3D hand tracking, using cross-sensor attention to modulate trust between vision and IMU signals during hand-object interaction with heavy occlusion.

entry.title: Virtual 3D H&E Staining from Phase-contrast Back-illumination Interference Tomography

author.name: Anthony Song, Boyan Zhou, Mayank Golhar, Marisa Morakis, Alex Baras, Nicholas Durr

entry.summary: HistoBIT3D presents the first voxel-wise paired dataset for Back-illumination Interference Tomography and fluorescence-labeled nuclei, enabling quantitative evaluation of virtual H&E staining for 3D histopathology without tissue processing.

entry.title: Diverse Yet Consistent: Context-Guided Diffusion with Energy-Based Joint Refinement for Multi-Agent Motion Prediction

author.name: Lei Chu, Yuhuan Zhao

entry.summary: A diffusion-based framework for multi-agent motion prediction that uses rich contextual information from historical trajectories as guidance to improve diversity while maintaining joint consistency among interacting agents.

entry.title: EventGait: Towards Robust Gait Recognition with Event Streams

author.name: Senyan Xu, Shuai Chen, Chuanfu Shen, Kean Liu, Zhijing Sun, Chengzhi Cao, Xueyang Fu

entry.summary: EventGait proposes an end-to-end dual-stream framework for gait recognition using event cameras, separately modeling motion and shape while preserving fine-grained temporal dynamics that traditional event image aggregation discards.

entry.title: Flow-based Gaussian Splatting for Continuous-Scale Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Jiangwei Mo, Xi Lu, Hanlin Wu

entry.summary: FlowGS combines flow matching with Gaussian splatting for arbitrary-scale super-resolution of remote sensing images, modeling high-frequency details between resolution levels with fast inference (few steps) compared to diffusion models.

entry.title: Event-Illumination Collaborative Low-light Image Enhancement with a High-resolution Real-world Dataset

author.name: Senyan Xu, Zhijing Sun, Kean Liu, Xin Lu, Ruixuan Jiang, Mingyang Huang, Xueyang Fu, Zheng-Jun Zha

entry.summary: EIC-LIE proposes event-illumination collaborative low-light image enhancement with a novel interaction module and illumination-aware event filter, accompanied by a high-resolution real-world dataset for evaluation.

entry.title: VEELA: A Clinically-Constrained Benchmark for Liver Vessel Segmentation in Computed Tomography Angiography

author.name: Ziya Ata Yaz{\i}c{\i}, N. Sinem Gezer, \.Ilkay \"Oks\"uz, \.Ilker \"Ozg\"ur Koska, Tu\u{g}\c{c}e Toprak, Pervin Bulucu, Ufuk Be\c{s}enk, A. Emre Kavur, Pierre-Henri Conze, Haz{\i}m Kemal Ekenel, O\u{g}uz Dicle, Mustafa Ege \c{S}eker, Mustafa Said Kartal, Ariorad Moniri, Orhan \"Ozkan, Osman Faruk Bayram, Hakan Polat, Musa Balc{\i}, Ece Tu\u{g}ba Cebeci, Baran C{\i}lga, Kardelen Pe\c{c}enek, M. Alper Selver

entry.summary: VEELA is a rigorously curated liver vessel dataset with slice-by-slice manual delineation under multi-expert consensus and strict visibility-driven annotation policy, avoiding anatomically inferred interpolation for clinically realistic benchmarking.

entry.title: Translating Signals to Languages for sEMG-Based Activity Recognition

author.name: Ming Wang, Haoxuan Qu, Qiuhong Ke, Wei Zhou, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes translating surface EMG signals into language representations for activity recognition using LLMs, leveraging the implicit knowledge of LLMs about actions learned from linguistic descriptions.

entry.title: FastTab: A Fast Table Recognizer with a Tiny Recursive Module and 1D Transformers

author.name: Laziz Hamdi, Amine Tamasna, Pascal Boisson, Thierry Paquet

entry.summary: FastTab is a grid-centric table structure recognition model that avoids autoregressive HTML decoding by using a Tiny Recursive Module for global reasoning and axial 1D Transformers for row/column dependencies, achieving competitive performance at low latency.

entry.title: Making the Discrete Continuous: Synthetic RAW Augmentations for Fine-Grained Evaluation of Person Detection Performance in Low Light

author.name: Valeria Pais, Malena Mendilaharzu, Daniele Faccio, Luis Oala, Christoph Clausen, Bruno Sanguinetti

entry.summary: Shows how synthetic low-light RAW image augmentations can provide continuous characterization of pedestrian detection performance as a function of scene illumination, filling gaps in sparse real-world test data distributions.

entry.title: FashionLens: Toward Versatile Fashion Image Retrieval via Task-Adaptive Learning

author.name: Haokun Wen, Xuemeng Song, Xinghao Xie, Xiaolin Chen, Xiangyu Zhao, Weili Guan

entry.summary: Introduces FashionLens, a unified framework for versatile fashion image retrieval supporting diverse query formats, along with U-FIRE benchmark that consolidates fragmented fashion datasets. Addresses the practical need for a single system handling multiple retrieval scenarios in e-commerce.

entry.title: A Task-Agnostic Algebraic Integrity Metric for Event-Camera Streams Toward SOTIF-Compliant Perception using Pearson Correlation Coefficient

author.name: Arthur de Miranda Neto

entry.summary: Proposes a task-agnostic algebraic quality metric for event camera streams based on Pearson Correlation Coefficient, addressing SOTIF/ISO certification requirements for automated driving that current task-dependent proxies cannot satisfy.

entry.title: Distributed Multi-Coverage for Robot Swarms

author.name: Mariem Guitouni, Aaron T. Becker

entry.summary: Presents a distributed multicoverage algorithm for robot swarms operating with local sensing and communication, where each asset requires observation by multiple robots with varying requirements based on importance.

entry.title: Scout-Assisted Planning for Heterogeneous Robot Teams under Partially Known Environments

author.name: Hoang-Dung Bui, Abhish Khanal, Raihan Islam Arnob, Gregory J. Stein

entry.summary: Proposes Scout-Assisted Planning for heterogeneous UAV-UGV teams where scout UAVs proactively gather environmental information. Uses a GNN-based model to efficiently predict information gain for prioritizing scouting actions.

entry.title: Adaptive RBF-KAN: A Comparative Evaluation of Dynamic Shape Parameters in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Roberto Cavoretto, Alessandra De Rossi, Adeeba Haider, Amir Noorizadegan

entry.summary: Extends RBF-based Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks by introducing a broader family of radial basis kernels with shape parameters initialized via leave-one-out cross-validation. First study integrating LOOCV-based kernel scale estimation with deep KAN training.

entry.title: From Sequential Nodes to GPU Batches: Parallel Branch and Bound for Optimal $k$-Sparse GLMs

author.name: Jiachang Liu, Andrea Lodi

entry.summary: Proposes a CPU-GPU framework for parallel branch and bound for optimal k-sparse GLMs, processing multiple BnB nodes in batches on GPUs with padding and custom kernels to overcome sequential processing bottlenecks.

entry.title: SDPM: Survival Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Continuous-Time Survival Analysis

author.name: Stanislav R. Kirpichenko, Andrei V. Konstantinov, Lev V. Utkin

entry.summary: Proposes SDPM, a denoising diffusion model for continuous-time survival analysis that models the joint distribution of observed time and censoring indicator, transforming generated samples into survival function estimates.

entry.title: Evaluating Temporal Semantic Caching and Workflow Optimization in Agentic Plan-Execute Pipelines

author.name: Alimurtaza Mustafa Merchant, Krish Veera, Sajal Kumar Goyla, Shambhawi Bhure, Dhaval Patel, Kaoutar El Maghraoui

entry.summary: Evaluates temporal semantic caching and workflow optimization for industrial asset operations, proposing a cache that respects time/asset/sensor parameters and MCP workflow optimizations for plan-execute pipelines.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Competency Assessment from Egocentric Video in Simulation-Based Nursing Education

author.name: Hanchen David Wang, Yilin Liu, Madison J. Lee, Surya Chand Rayala, Gautam Biswas, Daniel T. Levin, Meiyi Ma

entry.summary: Investigates automated competency assessment from egocentric nursing simulation video using frozen visual encoders and few-shot learning, extracting action timelines that correlate with instructor-rated competency.

entry.title: SegGuidedNet: Sub-Region-Aware Attention Supervision for Interpretable Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Hasaan Maqsood, Saif Ur Rehman Khan, Sebastian Vollmer, Andreas Dengel, Muhammad Nabeel Asim

entry.summary: Proposes SegGuidedNet for brain tumor segmentation with a novel SegAttentionGate module that explicitly supervises decoder attention maps for each tumor sub-region with minimal parameter overhead (<0.2%). Provides built-in interpretability through attention visualization.

entry.title: HyperBench: Standardizing and Scaling Synthetic Evaluation for Hyperspectral Super-Resolution

author.name: Ritik Shah, Marco F. Duarte

entry.summary: Presents HyperBench, a standardized benchmark for hyperspectral super-resolution that addresses inconsistent evaluation practices across research works by systematically varying PSFs, SRFs, and downsampling factors.

entry.title: OCELOT: Odometry and Contact Estimation for Legged Robots

author.name: Emre Girgin, Cagri Kilic

entry.summary: Presents OCELOT, a complete leg odometry pipeline using Error-State EKF with fused contact detection and uncertainty quantification for legged robots using only proprioceptive sensors (IMU, joint encoders, force sensors).

entry.title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment

author.name: Zhiqin Yang, Yonggang Zhang, Wei Xue, Dong Fang, Bo Han, Yike Guo

entry.summary: As first reported in Research yesterday, Proves that the equivalence between DPO and RLHF is conditional, not universal, depending on an implicit assumption that is frequently violated in practice. Characterizes failure modes where DPO converges to preferring dispreferred responses.

entry.title: Improving Viewpoint-Invariance and Temporal Consistency for Action Detection

author.name: Yannick Porto, Renato Martins, Thomas Chalumeau, Cedric Demonceaux

entry.summary: Introduces a two-stage action detection approach with virtual viewpoint augmentation during training and a view-invariant multi-scale temporal encoder for improving both viewpoint invariance and temporal coherence in untrimmed video action detection.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Human Action Recognition from Multiview Motion and Textual Descriptions

author.name: Yannick Porto, Renato Martins, Thomas Chalumeau, Cedric Demonceaux

entry.summary: Proposes a method for zero-shot action recognition that handles domain shifts from viewpoint changes by using multiview motion representations and textual descriptions for cross-domain generalization.

entry.title: Decoupling Ego-Motion from Target Dynamics via Dual-Interval Motion Cues for UAV Detection

author.name: Liuyang Wang, Feitian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-interval motion extraction strategy for UAV detection that decouples target motion from ego-motion through homography-based global motion compensation, addressing challenges of camera jitter and small object detection.

entry.title: From Automated to Autonomous: Hierarchical Agent-native Network Architecture (HANA)

author.name: Binghan Wu, Shoufeng Wang, Yunxin Liu, Ya-Qin Zhang, Joseph Sifakis, Ye Ouyang

entry.summary: HANA proposes a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for Level 4/5 autonomous networks, featuring a Dual-Driven Orchestrator coordinating specialized agents with shared memory and self-awareness capabilities. Validated in 5G Core environment.

entry.title: Declarative Data Services: Structured Agentic Discovery for Composing Data Systems

author.name: Shanshan Ye, Duo Lu

entry.summary: Declarative Data Services (DDS) proposes an architecture for structured agentic discovery of data-system compositions from user intent, using typed contracts to constrain LLM-driven search when composing heterogeneous data backends.

entry.title: AiraXiv: An AI-Driven Open-Access Platform for Human and AI Scientists

author.name: Junshu Pan, Panzhong Lu, Yixuan Weng, Qiyao Sun, Fang Guo, Zijie Yang, Qiji Zhou, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: AiraXiv proposes an AI-era academic publishing platform where both human and AI scientists participate as authors/readers, with papers evolving through continuous AI-augmented review and feedback-driven iteration.

entry.title: Improving Quantized Model Performance in Qualitative Analysis with Multi-Pass Prompt Verification

author.name: Aisvarya Adeseye, Jouni Isoaho, Adeyemi Adeseye

entry.summary: Examines how different quantization levels affect LLaMA-3.1 on qualitative analysis tasks and proposes a quantization-aware multi-pass prompt verification method to reduce hallucinations in low-bit models.

entry.title: PrivacyAkinator: Articulating Key Privacy Design Decisions by Answering LLM-Generated Multiple-choice Questions

author.name: Qiyu Li, Yuen Sum Wong, Yuen Kei Wong, Longxuan Yu, Haojian Jin

entry.summary: PrivacyAkinator helps developers articulate privacy design decisions by answering LLM-generated multiple-choice questions, lowering barriers to using NIST's Privacy Risk Assessment Methodology.

entry.title: Instance Discrimination for Link Prediction

author.name: Valentin Cuzin-Rambaud (SyCoSMA, DM2L, LIRIS, UCBL), Mathieu Lefort (LIRIS, SyCoSMA, IRISA, MALT, UR), R\'emy Cazabet (DM2L, LIRIS, UCBL, IXXI)

entry.summary: Adapts instance discrimination (self-supervised learning) methods to link prediction in graphs, proposing community-structure-based augmentation and showing augmentation strategy is key to performance.

entry.title: JUDO: A Juxtaposed Domain-Oriented Multimodal Reasoner for Industrial Anomaly QA

author.name: Hyunju Kang, Woohyun Lee, Jaewon Kim, Hogun Park

entry.summary: JUDO is a framework for industrial anomaly detection QA that incorporates domain knowledge into Large Multimodal Models by juxtaposing query images with normal reference images for fine-grained visual comparison. It addresses the gap between general-purpose LMMs and domain-specific industrial inspection needs.

entry.title: Co-Fusion4D: Spatio-temporal Collaborative Fusion for Robust 3D Object Detection

author.name: Wenxuan Li, Qin Zou, Shoubing Chen, Chi Chen, Yingyi Yang, Shoubing Chen, Qingxiang Meng

entry.summary: Co-Fusion4D is a framework for 3D object detection in autonomous driving that preserves cross-frame spatiotemporal consistency by using a current-frame-centric strategy that selectively incorporates historical frames after filtering and alignment.

entry.title: Consistently Informative Soft-Label Temperature for Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Hoang-Chau Luong, Nghia Van Vo, Kaiqi Zhao, Lingwei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes sample-adaptive temperature scaling for knowledge distillation that provides consistent entropy in teacher soft labels, addressing the problem that fixed temperature produces inconsistent information across samples with different logit scales.

entry.title: Tippett-minimum Fusion of Representation-space Diffusion Models for Multi-Encoder Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Neelkamal Bhuyan

entry.summary: Proposes multi-encoder fusion of representation-space diffusion models for OOD detection using a two-level min-gate that combines per-encoder detectors without OOD labels, achieving 2.3x lower parameter cost than monolithic baselines.

entry.title: Pareto-Enhanced Portrait Generation: Vision-Aligned Text Supervision for Alignment, Realism, and Aesthetics

author.name: Yunlong Wang, Jinjin Shi, Wenbin Gao, Xuran Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Pareto-enhanced portrait generation addressing the text-alignment/photorealism/aesthetics trilemma through feature supervision on MM-DiT, using cross-modal alignment with SigLIP 2 representations.

entry.title: ELSA: An ELastic SNN Inference Architecture for Efficient Neuromorphic Computing

author.name: Kang You, Chen Nie, Lee Jun Yan, Ziling Wei, Cheng Zou, Zekai Xu, Yu Feng, Honglan Jiang, Zhezhi He

entry.summary: Presents ELSA, an elastic SNN inference architecture that enables early output emergence in spiking neural networks, capitalizing on the temporal property that allows responses before full evaluation completes.

entry.title: Manga109-v2026: Revisiting Manga109 Annotations for Modern Manga Understanding

author.name: Jeonghun Baek, Atsuyuki Miyai, Shota Onohara, Hikaru Ikuta, Kiyoharu Aizawa

entry.summary: Revisits and corrects Manga109 dataset annotations for modern manga understanding tasks, identifying five categories of annotation issues and providing updated annotations for OCR and multimodal research.

entry.title: SAM-Sode: Towards Faithful Explanations for Tiny Bacteria Detection

author.name: Wanying Tan, Shuo Yan, Dazhi Huang, Yazheng Liu, Zili Shao, Rufeng Chen, Hechang Chen, Mude Shi, Tianxing Ji, Sihong Xie

entry.summary: Proposes SAM-Sode, an explainable AI framework for tiny bacteria detection that transforms feature attribution maps into geometry-aware prompts for SAM3 to achieve spatial refinement and morphological reconstruction.

entry.title: Enhanced Reinforcement Learning-based Process Synthesis via Quantum Computing

author.name: Austin Braniff (Department of Chemical and Biomedical Engineering, West Virginia University), Fengqi You (R.F. Smith School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Cornell University), Yuhe Tian (Department of Chemical and Biomedical Engineering, West Virginia University)

entry.summary: Presents quantum reinforcement learning for process synthesis, introducing state encoding algorithms to decouple qubit requirements from problem size, overcoming scalability limitations of prior quantum RL approaches.

entry.title: Ordering Matters: Rank-Aware Selective Fusion for Blended Emotion Recognition

author.name: Junghyun Lee, Hyunseo Kim, Hanna Jang, Junhyug Noh

entry.summary: Proposes a rank-aware multi-encoder framework for blended emotion recognition that selectively fuses only the top-n most informative encoders per sample. Decouples prediction into presence and salience heads with probability-level fusion.

entry.title: Physics-informed convolutional neural networks for fluid flow through porous media

author.name: Rafa{\l} Topolnicki, Pawe{\l} D{\l}otko, Maciej Matyka

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed CNN framework for predicting fluid flow velocity fields in porous media directly from geometry, using a custom loss combining velocity reconstruction with incompressibility constraints.

entry.title: Miller-Index-Based Latent Crystallographic Fracture Plane Reasoning with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Qinwu Xu, Yifan Jiang

entry.summary: Studies whether multimodal LLMs can use Miller indices (crystallographic plane indices) as latent representations for reasoning about fracture geometry, testing both latent inference and applicability assessment.

entry.title: Robust Recommendation from Noisy Implicit Feedback: A GMM-Weighted Bayes-label Transition Matrix Framework

author.name: Zongyu Li, Xuanyu Liu, Gongce Cao, Shirui Sun, Yaqi Fang, Yongshuai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes RGBT, a framework addressing noisy implicit feedback in recommender systems using GMM-derived reliability scores to calibrate Bayes-label transition matrix estimation.

entry.title: Beyond Numerical Features: CNN-Driven Algorithm Selection via Contour Plots for Continuous Black-Box Optimization

author.name: Yiliang Yuan, Xiang Shi, Mustafa Misir

entry.summary: Proposes using contour-map visualizations of optimization landscapes as CNN input for algorithm selection in black-box optimization, complementing numerical feature approaches like ELA.

entry.title: Nonparametric Learning and Earning with One-Point Feedback under Nonstationarity

author.name: Xiangyu Yang, Feng Xu, Jian-Qiang Hu, Jiaqiao Hu

entry.summary: Studies nonparametric dynamic pricing with one-point revenue feedback under nonstationarity, developing algorithms that learn demand without assuming parametric forms and adapt to changing environments.

entry.title: Quantum End-to-End Learning for Contextual Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Jaehwan Lee, Changhyun Kwon

entry.summary: Presents Quantum End-to-End Learning (QEL), the first quantum computing-based end-to-end learning framework for contextual combinatorial optimization using Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithms.

entry.title: The Economics of AI Inference: Inflation Dynamics, Welfare Costs, and Optimal Monetary Policy under the Inference-Cost Phillips Curve

author.name: Gustav Olaf Yunus Laitinen-Fredriksson Lundstr\"om-Imanov

entry.summary: Develops monetary theory of AI inference costs, introducing the Inference-Cost Phillips Curve augmenting New Keynesian economics with AI inference as a marginal cost component affecting inflation.

entry.title: Latent Geometry as a Structural Monitor: Eigenspace Alignment for Anomaly Detection in Anonymity Networks

author.name: Vaibhav Chhabra

entry.summary: Proposes structural anomaly detection in the Tor network using eigenspace alignment of behavioral population geometry, detecting structural pressure preceding major transitions.

entry.title: Oracle Supervision Transfers for Hyperparameter Prediction in Model-Based Image Denoising

author.name: Jianmin Liao, Lixin Shen, Yuesheng Xu

entry.summary: Proposes HyperDn for transferring oracle supervision across configurations in model-based image denoising, enabling a single configuration-conditioned predictor to reduce labeling costs.

entry.title: Automated Byzantine-Resilient Clustered Decentralized Federated Learning for Battery Intelligence in Connected EVs

author.name: Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha, Abdelaziz Amara Korba, Yacine Ghamri-Doudane

entry.summary: Proposes ABC-DFL, a Byzantine-resilient decentralized federated learning framework for connected electric vehicles, using blockchain-based aggregation and dynamic fault tolerance for battery intelligence applications.

entry.title: ArabDiscrim: A Decade-Long Arabic Facebook Corpus on Racism and Discrimination

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani, Shimaa Amer Ibrahim, Mabrouka Bessghaier, Houda Bouamor

entry.summary: Presents ArabDiscrim, a decade-long corpus of 293K Arabic Facebook posts on racism and discrimination with engagement signals, curated terms, and morphological regex families.

entry.title: Psy-Chronicle:A Structured Pipeline for Synthesizing Long-Horizon Campus Psychological Counseling Dialogues

author.name: Chaogui Gou, Jiarui Liang

entry.summary: Proposes Psy-Chronicle, a framework for synthesizing long-horizon campus psychological counseling dialogues with semester-spanning stress event graphs to model how psychological distress accumulates over time.

entry.title: More Context, Larger Models, or Moral Knowledge? A Systematic Study of Schwartz Value Detection in Political Texts

author.name: V\'ictor Yeste, Paolo Rosso

entry.summary: Systematically compares approaches for detecting Schwartz values in political text, examining context length, RAG augmentation, supervised encoders, and zero-shot LLMs. Finds full-document context helps supervised models but not LLMs, and RAG provides inconsistent benefits.

entry.title: Improving 3D Labeling in Self-Driving by Inferring Vehicle Information using Vision Language Models

author.name: Steven Chen, Shivesh Khaitan, Nemanja Djuric

entry.summary: Uses Vision Language Models for zero-shot vehicle identification and 3D bounding box estimation in self-driving labeling pipelines. Evaluates VLMs on make/model/generation recognition for improved labeling efficiency.

entry.title: Bounding-Box Trajectories Matter for Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Inpyo Song, Jangwon Lee

entry.summary: TrajVAD leverages bounding-box trajectories as a primary anomaly cue for video anomaly detection, noting that this information is already available in pose-based pipelines but often overlooked. The framework models multi-class trajectory patterns to detect anomalies.

entry.title: AgroVG: A Large-Scale Multi-Source Benchmark for Agricultural Visual Grounding

author.name: Haocheng Li, Juepeng Zheng, Zenghao Yang, Kaiqi Du, Guilong Xiao, Gengmeng Pu, Haohuan Fu, Jianxi Huang

entry.summary: AgroVG is a multi-source benchmark for agricultural visual grounding that tests localization accuracy, target-set completeness, and existence-aware abstention, addressing the unique challenges of agricultural targets being small, repetitive, and irregularly shaped.

entry.title: GenHAR: Generalizing Cross-domain Human Activity Recognition for Last-mile Delivery

author.name: Zhiqing Hong, Zelong Li, Xiubin Fan, Guang Yang, Baoshen Guo, Haotian Wang, Tian He, Desheng Zhang

entry.summary: GenHAR addresses domain shift in Human Activity Recognition for last-mile delivery by learning domain-invariant sensor representations through frequency tokenization and cross-domain correlation learning, improving generalization without target domain data.

entry.title: Balancing Uncertainty and Diversity of Samples: Leveraging Diversity of Least, High Confidence Samples for Effective Active Learning

author.name: Vipul Arya, S. H. Shabbeer Basha, Srikrishna U N, Sunainha Vijay, Snehasis Mukherjee

entry.summary: Proposes a new active learning strategy that balances uncertainty and diversity by focusing on diverse selection among the least uncertain (high confidence) samples, challenging the conventional focus on uncertain samples.

entry.title: Ultra-High-Definition Image Quality Assessment via Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Shaode Yu, Enqi Chen, Ming Huang, Xuemin Ren, Songnan Zhao, Zhicheng Zhang, Qiurui Sun

entry.summary: Proposes a graph representation learning framework (UHD-GCN-BIQA) for ultra-high-definition image quality assessment that models structural dependencies among sampled patches using hybrid k-nearest-neighbor graphs.

entry.title: OSS: Open Suturing Skills Vision-Based Assessment Challenge 2024-2025

author.name: Hanna Hoffmann, Setareh Bady, Claas de Boer, Max Kirchner, Jan Egger, Rainer R\"ohrig, Frank H\"olzle, Lennart Johannes Gruber, Kunpeng Xie, Marlon Neuhaus, Victor Alves, Guilherme Barbosa, Leonardo Barroso, Jo\~ao Carvalho, Hao Chen, Gabriella d'Albenzio, Andr\'e Ferreira, Nuno Gomes, Yuichiro Hayashi, Kousuke Hirasawa, Rebecca Hisey, Seungjae Hong, Seoi Jeong, Tiago Jesus, Daehong Kang, Satoshi Kasai, Shunsuke Kikuchi, Takayuki Kitasaka, Satoshi Kondo, Hyoun-Joong Kong, Youngbin Kong, Atsushi Kouno, Shlomi Laufer, Kyu Eun Lee, Bining Long, Nooshin Maghsoodi, Hiroki Matsuzaki, Evangelos Mazomenos, Ori Meiraz, Kensaku Mori, Marina Music, Masahiro Oda, Roi Papo, Jieun Park, Rafael Piexoto, Saeid Rezaei, Mariana Ribeiro, Soyeon Shin, Yang Shu, Idan Smoller, Danail Stoyanov, Yihui Wang, Xinkai Zhao, Sebastian Bodenstedt, Isabel Funke, Stefanie Speidel, Behrus Hinrichs-Puladi

entry.summary: OSS presents results from a MICCAI challenge for vision-based surgical skill assessment in open suturing, benchmarking automated methods on dry-lab training videos with instrument trajectories.

entry.title: 3D LULC classification using multispectral LiDAR and deep learning: current and prospective schemes

author.name: Narges Takhtkeshha, Aldino Rizaldy, Markus Hollaus, Juha Hyypp\"a, Fabio Remondino, Gottfried Mandlburger

entry.summary: Introduces NMCA-aligned LULC classification schemes and a benchmark multispectral LiDAR dataset, evaluating seven deep learning models for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation with spectral ablation studies.

entry.title: Training-Free Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentations in Low Data Regimes: A FungiTastic Baseline

author.name: Sebastian Cavada, Francesco Pelosin, Lapo Faggi

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free two-stage framework for fine-grained semantic segmentation that uses SAM3 for class-agnostic masks and DINOv3 for prototype-based classification in the embedding space. Applied to mushroom segmentation with long-tailed distributions. Demonstrates scalability over class-specific prompting approaches.

entry.title: Tackle CSM in JPEG Steganalysis with Data Adaptation

author.name: Rony Abecidan (CRIStAL), Vincent Itier (IMT Nord Europe, CRIStAL), J\'er\'emie Boulanger (CRIStAL), Patrick Bas (CRIStAL), Tom\'a\v{s} Pevn\'y (CTU)

entry.summary: Introduces TADA for JPEG steganalysis that learns to emulate unknown processing pipelines from small unlabeled target sets to address Cover Source Mismatch. Uses residual covariance alignment and distribution matching.

entry.title: Motion Design for Grasp-Based Dynamic Locomotion in Microgravity

author.name: Chaerim Moon, Joohyung Kim, Justin K. Yim

entry.summary: Presents design insights for grasp-based dynamic locomotion in microgravity for multi-limbed robots, investigating gait patterns, stride length, speed, and posture parameters with a parameterizable planning framework.

entry.title: Real-Time Auto-Optimization in Unknown Environments via Structure-Exploiting Dual Control for Exploration and Exploitation

author.name: Shiying Dong, Haoyang Yang, Qiwei Liu, Wen-Hua Chen

entry.summary: Develops a fast numerical dual control method for exploration-exploitation (DCEE) that exploits convex-over-nonlinear structure in the reward function, enabling real-time auto-optimization in unknown environments.

entry.title: TriSweep: A Four-Drone Swarm Framework for Electromagnetic Side-Channel Analysis

author.name: Eric Yocam, Varghese Vaidyan

entry.summary: TriSweep is a simulation framework for a four-drone swarm that performs electromagnetic side-channel analysis at standoff distances, demonstrating coherent combining for SNR gain and second-order mask cancellation using multiple spatially separated drones.

entry.title: Support-aware offline policy selection for advertising marketplaces

author.name: Prashant Shekhar, Caroline Howard

entry.summary: Develops a support-aware offline decision framework for reserve-price policy selection in advertising that outputs certified policies, flagged policies needing validation, and rejected policies, rather than just a point-estimate winner.

entry.title: CryoNet: A Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Modal Debris-Covered Glacier Mapping. A Case Study of the Poiqu Basin, Central Himalaya

author.name: Farzaneh Barzegar, Tobias Bolch, Norbert Kuehtreiber, Silvia L. Ullo

entry.summary: Introduces CryoNet, a deep learning framework combining multi-modal satellite data for discriminating clean-ice glaciers, debris-covered glaciers, and glacial lakes using an encoder-decoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention.

entry.title: Engineering Hybrid Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Next-Generation Electricity Systems: A State-of-the-Art Review

author.name: Joseph Nyangon

entry.summary: Reviews hybrid physics-informed ML architectures for electricity systems including PINNs, DeepONets, Fourier Neural Operators, and graph-based PINNs for Industry 4.0 applications in power grid design, monitoring, and control.

entry.title: Parallel LLM Reasoning for Bias-Resilient, Robust Conceptual Abstraction

author.name: Aisvarya Adeseye, Jouni Isoaho, Adeyemi Adeseye

entry.summary: Proposes parallel chunk-level processing with evidence-anchored consolidation to reduce contextual reasoning limitations of LLMs on long documents, addressing cumulative bias and conceptual drift.

entry.title: Leveraging Vision-Language Models to Detect Attention in Educational Videos

author.name: Gabriel Becquet (LIP6, CNRS, SU), S\'ebastien Lall\'e (CNRS, LIP6, SU), Vanda Luengo (LIP6, CNRS, SU), Ali Abou-Hassan (SU, CNRS, PHENIX, IUF)

entry.summary: Uses vision-language models to detect attention/engagement in educational videos from eye tracking data, moving beyond engineered features to foundation model representations.

entry.title: Efficient Table QA via TableGrid Navigation and Progressive Inference Prompting

author.name: Amritansh Maurya, Navjot Singh, Mohammed Javed, Omar Moured

entry.summary: Proposes two training-free prompting frameworks for Table QA: TableGrid Navigation (iterative row/column navigation) and Progressive Inference Prompting (structured column-first reasoning).

entry.title: WaveGraphNet: Physics-Consistent Guided-Wave Damage Localization through Coupled Inverse-Forward Graph Learning

author.name: Vinay Sharma, Aditya Bharade, Olga Fink

entry.summary: Proposes WaveGraphNet, a coupled inverse-forward graph learning framework for guided-wave damage localization in composite plates, explicitly modeling the sensing layout as a graph.

entry.title: Decision-Path Patterns as Tree Reliability Signals: Path-based Adaptive Weighting for Random Forest Classification

author.name: Youngjoon Park

entry.summary: Proposes path-based adaptive weighting for Random Forests using decision-path patterns as tree reliability signals, exploiting class label flip patterns along root-to-leaf paths.

entry.title: Audience Engagement with Arabic Women's Social Empowerment and Wellbeing: A Decadal Corpus

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani, Mabrouka Bessghaier, MD. Rafiul Biswas, Shimaa Amer Ibrahim

entry.summary: Presents a decade-long corpus of 252K Arabic Facebook posts on women's empowerment with engagement metrics from 77 countries, enabling analysis of gender discourse and emotional engagement patterns.

entry.title: Cell Phantom Video Generation in Elliptical Fourier Descriptor Domain

author.name: Francesco Benedetto, Roberto Basla, Luca Magri, Giacomo Boracchi

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for generating synthetic cell tracking videos using Elliptical Fourier Descriptors to ensure temporal consistency of cell shapes. Addresses data scarcity in biomedical cell tracking by generating realistic phantom cells that replicate biological processes.

entry.title: An Evidence Hierarchy for Bayesian Object Classification via OSINT-Aided Heterogeneous Sensor Fusion

author.name: Jan Nausner, Michael Hubner

entry.summary: Proposes a context-aware Bayesian fusion framework with a novel evidence hierarchy for heterogeneous sensor classification of CBRNE threats, using OSINT data to mitigate sensor shortcomings.

entry.title: Time-varying rPPG signal separation via block-sparse signal model

author.name: Kosuke Kurihara, Yoshihiro Maeda, Daisuke Sugimura, Takayuki Hamamoto

entry.summary: Proposes an rPPG signal extraction method exploiting quasi-periodic characteristics modeled as block-sparse structure in time-frequency domain, with adaptive signal separation under illumination fluctuations.

entry.title: Pseudo-Siamese Network for Planning in Target-Oriented Proactive Dialogues

author.name: Xinyue Kang, Maodong Li, Yibin Zheng, Fang Kong

entry.summary: FF-BPSN uses a pseudo-Siamese network with forward and backward planning decoders for dialogue path planning in target-oriented proactive dialogue systems.

entry.title: Security Document Classification with a Fine-Tuned Local Large Language Model: Benchmark Data and an Open-Source System

author.name: Ivan Dobrovolskyi

entry.summary: TorchSight is an open-source local system for security document classification using a fine-tuned Qwen 3.5 27B model, achieving 95% accuracy vs 75-79% for commercial models on security document categorization across 7 categories.

entry.title: Latent Space Guided Scenario Sampling for Multimodal Segmentation Under Missing Modalities

author.name: Irem Ulku, \"O. \"Ozg\"ur Tanr{\i}\"over, Erdem Akag\"und\"uz

entry.summary: Proposes a training strategy for multimodal segmentation that learns scenario sampling distributions from pretrained latent spaces, rather than uniform random modality dropout, to handle missing modalities in remote sensing.

entry.title: Automated ICD Classification of Psychiatric Diagnoses: From Classical NLP to Large Language Models

author.name: Fernando Ortega, Ra\'ul Lara-Cabrera, Jorge Due\~nas-Ler\'in, Alejandro de la Torre-Luque, Merc\'e Salvador Robert, Enrique Baca-Garc\'ia

entry.summary: Proposes automating psychiatric ICD diagnosis coding from Spanish free-text descriptions using NLP, comparing classical methods to transformer-based embeddings on 145K psychiatric descriptions.

entry.title: RePCM: Region-Specific and Phenotype-Adaptive Bi-Ventricular Cardiac Motion Synthesis

author.name: Xuan Yang, Xiaohan Yuan, Hao Li, Lingyu Chen, Yanan Liu, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes RePCM for synthesizing full cardiac cycle motion from a single end-diastolic frame, using region-aware and phenotype-adaptive approaches to handle disease-specific differences in bi-ventricular motion.

entry.title: FedCritic: Serverless Federated Critic Learning-based Resource Allocation for Multi-Cell OFDMA in 6G

author.name: Amin Farajzadeh, Melike Erol-Kantarci

entry.summary: Proposes FedCritic, a serverless federated multi-agent actor-critic framework for distributed resource management in 6G networks. Addresses inter-cell interference in OFDMA scheduling without requiring centralized critics.

entry.title: OpenSeisML: Open Large-Scale Real Seismic and well-log Dataset for Generative AI

author.name: Ipsita Bhar, Huseyin Tuna Erdinc, Thales Souza, Charles Jones, Felix J. Herrmann

entry.summary: Releases OpenSeisML, a collection of real seismic datasets curated from UK public repositories for generative AI workflows in seismic inversion, with time-to-depth conversion pipeline.

entry.title: Prism: Structural Symmetry Scanning via Duality-Constrained Laplacian Projection

author.name: Jiatong Xie

entry.summary: Introduces Prism, a framework for structural symmetry diagnosis in networks using duality defect metrics based on graph Laplacians and symmetric involutions.

entry.title: Understanding Deterioration Random Effects for Causal Discovery in Infrastructure Management

author.name: Takato Yasuno

entry.summary: Combines Bayesian hierarchical hazard modeling with causal discovery (DirectLiNGAM) to identify operational patterns driving heterogeneous deterioration rates in pump equipment.

entry.title: Genetic Programming with Transformer-Based Mutation for Approximate Circuit Design

author.name: Ondrej Galeta, Lukas Sekanina

entry.summary: Proposes using transformer-based mutation operators in Cartesian genetic programming for designing approximate arithmetic circuits. A hybrid scheme alternates between standard and learned mutations to prevent stagnation.

entry.title: Broadening Access to Transportation Safety Data with Generative AI: A Schema-Grounded Framework for Spatial Natural Language Queries

author.name: Mahdi Azhdari, Eric J. Gonzales

entry.summary: Presents a schema-grounded natural language interface for transportation safety analysis, enabling non-technical stakeholders to query crash data, roadway attributes, and geospatial information using natural language.

entry.title: A Tutorial on Diffusion Theory: From Differential Equations to Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiayi Fu, Yuxia Wang

entry.summary: A tutorial developing diffusion models from the differential equations viewpoint, covering forward/reverse SDEs, probability-flow ODEs, score matching, and various design choices in modern architectures.

entry.title: VISTA: Validation-Guided Integration of Spatial and Temporal Foundation Models with Anatomical Decoding for Rare-Pathology VCE Event Detection -- after competition results

author.name: Bo-Cheng Qiu, Fang-Ying Lin, Ming-Han Sun, Yu-Fan Lin, Chia-Ming Lee, Chih-Chung Hsu

entry.summary: VISTA combines temporal and spatial foundation models (EndoFM-LV and DINOv3) for capsule endoscopy event detection with validation-guided fusion and anatomy-aware temporal decoding, achieving strong results on the RAREVISION challenge.

entry.title: GALAR-TemporalNet v2: Anatomy-Guided Dual-Branch Temporal Classification with Bidirectional Mamba and Dual-Graph GCN for Video Capsule Endoscopy -- after competition results

author.name: Jiye Won (Kyungpook National University), Seangmin Lee (Kyungpook National University), Soon Ki Jung (Kyungpook National University)

entry.summary: GALAR-TemporalNet v2 addresses video capsule endoscopy classification with a hierarchical temporal model combining windowed self-attention, dual-graph GCN, and bidirectional Mamba for handling class imbalance and long-range dependencies.

entry.title: Entropy-Guided Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Classification

author.name: Joao Florindo, Viviane Moura

entry.summary: Introduces a synergistic framework combining ImageNet-pretrained and entropy-guided MAE-pretrained ConvNeXt-Tiny models for medical image classification, leveraging complementary representations from natural and medical image pretraining.

entry.title: Impact of Atmospheric Turbulence and Pointing Error on Earth Observation

author.name: Celia S\'anchez-de-Miguel, Antonio M. Mercado-Mart\'inez, Beatriz Soret, Antonio Jurado-Navas, Miguel Castillo-V\'azquez

entry.summary: Presents an image simulator incorporating atmospheric turbulence and satellite pointing jitter for Earth Observation, evaluating impact on vessel detection performance with YOLOv8 and RetinaNet showing significant recall degradation.

entry.title: Industrial Dual-Arm Box Handling via Online Inertial Estimation and Convex Wrench Optimization

author.name: Kenzhi Iskandar Wong, Lin Yang, Qian Ying Lee, Domenico Campolo

entry.summary: Presents a friction-aware dual-arm box-handling framework that estimates object mass and center of mass online from contact wrenches, then computes friction-feasible contact forces via second-order cone programming for objects with unknown inertial properties.

entry.title: N3P: Accelerated Automated Parking via a Learning-Based Naturalistic Three-Stage Scheme

author.name: Yifan Xue, Toktam Mohammadnejad, Faizan M Tariq, Sangjae Bae, David Isele, Yosuke Sakamoto, Nadia Figueroa, Jovin D'sa

entry.summary: Presents N3P, a learning-based three-stage framework for automated parking that decomposes the maneuver by introducing an intermediate preparatory pose predicted by a learning module, reducing computational complexity compared to Hybrid A*.

entry.title: High Quality Embeddings for Horn Logic Reasoning

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Yasir White, Dean Clark, Joseph Sanchez, Jevon Lipsey, Ashely Hirst, Jeff Heflin

entry.summary: Introduces improved embedding methods for Horn logic reasoning using triplet loss training, with novel approaches to anchor generation, example balancing, and hard example emphasis. Results in more efficient logical reasoning searches.

entry.title: VBFDD-Agent for Electric Vehicle Battery Fault Detection and Diagnosis: Descriptive Text Modeling of Battery Digital Signals

author.name: Joey Chan, Zhen Chen, Ershun Pan

entry.summary: VBFDD-Agent proposes a descriptive text modeling approach for EV battery fault detection, converting digital signals to text representations for LLM-based diagnosis with cross-domain adaptability.

entry.title: Teaching AI Through Benchmark Construction: QuestBench as a Course-Based Practice for Accountable Knowledge Work

author.name: Haiyang Shen, Jiuzheng Wang, Taian Guo, Mugeng Liu, Wenchun Jing, Chongyang Pan, Siqi Zhong, Zhiyang Chen, Weichen Bi, Yudong Han, Xiaoying Bai, Yun Ma

entry.summary: Proposes a course-based practice where students learn to evaluate AI by constructing benchmarks (QuestBench), turning disciplinary knowledge into verifiable expert-level questions for AI systems.

entry.title: You Don't Need Attention: Gated Convolutional Modeling for Watch-Based Fall Detection

author.name: Sana Alamgeer, Ronish Kumar, Awatif Yasmin, Muhammad Irshad, Anne H. H. Ngu

entry.summary: Gated-CNN proposes a lightweight dual-stream architecture for smartwatch-based fall detection that uses sigmoid gating instead of attention, achieving better performance with lower computational cost.

entry.title: FusionCell: Cross-Attentive Fusion of Layout Geometry and Netlist Topology for Standard-Cell Performance Prediction

author.name: Haoyi Zhang, Kairong Guo, Bojie Zhang, Yibo Lin, Runsheng Wang

entry.summary: FusionCell is a dual-modality predictor for standard cell performance (delay/power) that fuses routed layout geometry with netlist topology using DeiT and graph transformers with cross-attention. It addresses the slow simulation sweeps needed for chip characterization.

entry.title: Representability-Aware Neural Networks for Reduced Density Matrices: Application to Fractional Chern Insulators

author.name: Justin B. Hart, Awwab A. Azam, Thomas Li, Yunxuan Li, Ye Bi, Haining Pan, Jiabin Yu

entry.summary: Develops representability-aware neural networks for predicting two-particle reduced density matrices, applied to fractional Chern insulators in twisted bilayer MoTe₂. Incorporates physical constraints through architecture and loss function.

entry.title: Nonlocal operator learning for fMRI encoding and decoding tasks

author.name: Andreas Kramer, Saugat Acharya, Alice Giola, Emanuele Zappala

entry.summary: Investigates neural integral-operator-based models for fMRI encoding and decoding tasks, focusing on the role of nonlocal spatiotemporal context. Implements a latent neural integral operator framework with fixed point iterations.

entry.title: Faster or Stronger: Towards Flexible Visual Place Recognition via Weighted Aggregation and Token Pruning

author.name: Zichao Zeng, June Moh Goo, Junwei Zheng, Weijia Fan, Jiaming Zhang, Rainer Stiefelhagen, Jan Boehm

entry.summary: Proposes Weighted Aggregated Descriptor (WeiAD) for visual place recognition that assigns weights to clusters during aggregation, plus a token pruning strategy for flexible speed-accuracy tradeoff with Vision Transformers.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 21, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by challenges to core assumptions in LLM training and evaluation. A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering (Stanford, Duchi & Hashimoto) argues data filtering is unnecessary in high-compute regimes, potentially reshaping pretraining pipelines industry-wide. optimize_anything (Stoica, Kolter, Zaharia et al.) introduces a universal optimization API treating any problem as text artifact improvement.

  • Lying Is Just a Phase discovers a phase transition at ~3.5B parameters where reasoning and truthfulness coupling flips from antagonistic to synergistic
  • The Illusion of Intervention formally proves LLM-simulated experiments are observational studies, undermining a growing research paradigm
  • Base Models Look Human To AI Detectors shows non-instruction-tuned models bypass GPTZero and similar tools, challenging deployed detection infrastructure
  • Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF proves DPO's implicit assumption is frequently violated in practice, explaining known failure modes

In evaluation and safety: AI Reviewers study with 45 experts on Nature-family papers characterizes systematic failure modes beyond score alignment. Toto 2.0 demonstrates scaling laws apply to time series foundation models up to 2.5B parameters. Critical analysis of TTRL reveals majority voting can lock in wrong answers. From 8B to Frontier finds system prompts dramatically modulate harmful behavior across 22 models, with significant variance between labs.
entry.content:
Today's research is dominated by challenges to core assumptions in LLM training and evaluation. A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering (Stanford, Duchi & Hashimoto) argues data filtering is unnecessary in high-compute regimes, potentially reshaping pretraining pipelines industry-wide. optimize_anything (Stoica, Kolter, Zaharia et al.) introduces a universal optimization API treating any problem as text artifact improvement.

  • Lying Is Just a Phase discovers a phase transition at ~3.5B parameters where reasoning and truthfulness coupling flips from antagonistic to synergistic
  • The Illusion of Intervention formally proves LLM-simulated experiments are observational studies, undermining a growing research paradigm
  • Base Models Look Human To AI Detectors shows non-instruction-tuned models bypass GPTZero and similar tools, challenging deployed detection infrastructure
  • Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF proves DPO's implicit assumption is frequently violated in practice, explaining known failure modes

In evaluation and safety: AI Reviewers study with 45 experts on Nature-family papers characterizes systematic failure modes beyond score alignment. Toto 2.0 demonstrates scaling laws apply to time series foundation models up to 2.5B parameters. Critical analysis of TTRL reveals majority voting can lock in wrong answers. From 8B to Frontier finds system prompts dramatically modulate harmful behavior across 22 models, with significant variance between labs.

entry.title: On the limits and opportunities of AI reviewers: Reviewing the reviews of Nature-family papers with 45 expert scientists

author.name: Seungone Kim, Dongkeun Yoon, Kiril Gashteovski, Juyoung Suk, Jinheon Baek, Pranjal Aggarwal, Ian Wu, Viktor Zaverkin, Spase Petkoski, Daniel R. Schrider, Ilija Dukovski, Francesco Santini, Biljana Mitreska, Yong Jeong, Kyeongha Kwon, Young Min Sim, Dragana Manasova, Arthur Porto, Biljana Mojsoska, Makoto Takamoto, Marko Shuntov, Ruoqi Liu, Hyunjoo Jenny Lee, Niyazi Ulas Din\c{c}, Yehhyun Jo, Sunkyu Han, Chungwoo Lee, Huishan Li, Esther H. R. Tsai, Ergun Simsek, Khushboo Shafi, Yeonseung Chung, Jihye Park, Aleksandar Shulevski, Henrik Christiansen, Yoosang Son, Elly Knight, Amanda Montoya, Jeongyoun Ahn, Christian Langkammer, Heera Moon, Changwon Yoon, Nikola Stikov, Mooseok Jang, Edward Choi, Junhan Kim, Yeon Sik Jung, Woo Youn Kim, Jae Kyoung Kim, Ishraq Md Anjum, Hyun Uk Kim, Drew Bridges, Carolin Lawrence, Xiang Yue, Alice Oh, Akari Asai, Sean Welleck, Graham Neubig

entry.summary: Large-scale study with 45 expert scientists evaluating AI reviewer capabilities on Nature-family papers, going beyond score alignment to characterize specific strengths and limitations of AI peer review.

entry.title: The Illusion of Intervention: Your LLM-Simulated Experiment is an Observational Study

author.name: Victoria Lin, Taedong Yun, Maja Matari\'c, John Canny, Arthur Gretton, Alexander D'Amour

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLM-simulated experiments are effectively observational studies because training on observational data causes intervention-dependent shifts in latent user attributes (user drift), distorting causal effect estimates.

entry.title: When the Majority Votes Wrong, the Intervention Timing for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning Hides in the Extinction Window

author.name: Hongxiang Lin, Zhirui Kuai, Erpeng Xue, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Critically analyzes test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL), arguing that reported accuracy gains mostly reflect sharpening of already-solvable problems rather than genuine learning. Identifies a 'Correct-Answer Extinction Window' where correct signals are briefly active before being permanently suppressed by majority vote.

entry.title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment

author.name: Zhiqin Yang, Yonggang Zhang, Wei Xue, Dong Fang, Bo Han, Yike Guo

entry.summary: Proves that DPO-RLHF equivalence is conditional on an implicit assumption (that the RLHF-optimal policy prefers human-preferred responses) which is frequently violated, leading to pathological convergence where DPO loss decreases while the model prefers dispreferred responses.

entry.title: How Far Are We From True Auto-Research?

author.name: Zhengxin Zhang, Ning Wang, Sainyam Galhotra, Claire Cardie

entry.summary: Introduces ResearchArena, evaluating auto-research systems (Claude Code/Opus 4.6, Codex/GPT-5.4, Kimi Code/K2.5) on the full research loop across 117 agent-generated papers. Uses multiple evaluation lenses including manuscript review, artifact-aware peer review, and cross-agent comparison.

entry.title: What Really Improves Mathematical Reasoning: Structured Reasoning Signals Beyond Pure Code

author.name: Yuze Zhao, Junpeng Fang, Lu Yu, Zhenya Huang, Kai Zhang, Qing Cui, Qi Liu, Jun Zhou, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Challenges the claim that code training improves general reasoning in LLMs through controlled 10T-token pretraining experiments. Shows standalone code mainly improves programming, while reasoning gains come from cross-domain structured reasoning traces like code-text annotations.

entry.title: Features have life history. And we should care

author.name: Philipp Stecher, Sandro Radovanovi\'c, Vlasta Sikimi\'c, Reinhard Kahle

entry.summary: Discovers a 'carrier scaffold' of ~50 sparse features with stable life histories in Pythia models that forms early in training and is load-bearing for the model's representational structure. Shows features emerge, persist, and die during training with meaningful dynamics.

entry.title: Agent Security is a Systems Problem

author.name: Mihai Christodorescu, Earlence Fernandes, Ashish Hooda, Somesh Jha, Johann Rehberger, Kamalika Chaudhuri, Xiaohan Fu, Khawaja Shams, Guy Amir, Jihye Choi, Sarthak Choudhary, Nils Palumbo, Andrey Labunets, Nishit V. Pandya

entry.summary: Argues that agent security must be treated as a systems problem where the AI model is an untrusted component, and security invariants must be enforced at the system level rather than relying solely on model robustness.

entry.title: When to Stop Reusing: Dynamic Gradient Gating for Sample-Efficient RLVR

author.name: Yuchun Miao, Sen Zhang, Yuqi Zhang, Yaorui Shi, Qi Gu, Xunliang Cai, Lefei Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies the 'Disproportionate Weight Divergence' phenomenon in RLVR where policy degradation correlates with sharp changes in the lm_head weights. Proposes dynamic gradient gating to determine when to stop reusing rollout batches, improving sample efficiency in reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning.

entry.title: A Measure-Theoretic Analysis of Reasoning: Structural Generalization and Approximation Limits

author.name: Yuyang Zhang, Yifu Zhang, Xuehai Zhou, Xiaoyin Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes LLM reasoning via optimal transport, projecting trajectories into continuous metric space to bound OOD generalization using Wasserstein distance and Lipschitz continuity. Shows position-dependent attention fails shift invariance while rotary embeddings preserve it.

entry.title: LLM Benchmark Datasets Should Be Contamination-Resistant

author.name: Ali Al-Lawati, Jason Lucas, Dongwon Lee, Suhang Wang

entry.summary: Argues LLM benchmark datasets should be contamination-resistant (unlearnable during training but supporting inference). Highlights how Transformer architecture asymmetries between training and inference can be leveraged for this purpose.

entry.title: ThoughtTrace: Understanding User Thoughts in Real-World LLM Interactions

author.name: Chuanyang Jin, Binze Li, Haopeng Xie, Cathy Mengying Fang, Tianjian Li, Shayne Longpre, Hongxiang Gu, Maximillian Chen, Tianmin Shu

entry.summary: Introduces ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset pairing real multi-turn human-AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts (reasons for prompts and reactions to responses). Covers 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations across 20 language models, showing that user thoughts are semantically distinct from messages and hard for LLMs to infer.

entry.title: Introspective X Training: Feedback Conditioning Improves Scaling Across all LLM Training Stages

author.name: Brandon Cui, Ximing Lu, Jaehun Jung, Syeda Nahida Akter, Hyunwoo Kim, Yuxiao Qu, David Acuna, Shrimai Prabhumoye, Yejin Choi, Prithviraj Ammanabrolu

entry.summary: Proposes Introspective Training (IXT), using a thinking reward model to annotate training data with natural language critique-based feedback from the earliest stages of LLM training, enabling quality-aware training via prefix-conditioning throughout the pipeline.

entry.title: ChunkFT: Byte-Streamed Optimization for Memory-Efficient Full Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yongkang Liu, Zijing Wang, Mengjie Zhao, Ercong Nie, Mingyang Wang, Qian Li, Feiliang Ren, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: ChunkFT enables full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (7B-70B) on consumer GPUs by dynamically activating sub-tensor working sets for gradient computation. It achieves full fine-tuning of a 7B model with only 13.72GB GPU memory, making it practical on a single RTX 4090.

entry.title: Self-Training Doesn't Flatten Language -- It Restructures It: Surface Markers Amplify While Deep Syntax Dies

author.name: Ming Liu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that successive self-training doesn't uniformly flatten language but restructures it asymmetrically: surface markers (hedges, discourse connectives) amplify while deep syntactic structures (passives, subjunctives) collapse. Formalizes this as the Structural Depth Hypothesis.

entry.title: Trusted Weights, Treacherous Optimizations? Optimization-Triggered Backdoor Attacks on LLMs

author.name: Yifei Wang, Tianlin Li, Xiaohan Zhang, Yida Yang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Li Pan

entry.summary: Uncovers that numerical side effects of LLM inference compilation can be maliciously exploited to implant stealthy backdoors that activate only when models are compiled, remaining dormant under uncompiled execution.

entry.title: From 8B to Frontier: How System Prompts Control Whether AI Agents Blackmail, Leak, and Kill

author.name: Chijioke Ugwuanyi

entry.summary: Extended study testing 22 models from 9 developers across 3 harm scenarios (blackmail, espionage, murder) and 5 instruction conditions. Finds OpenAI/Anthropic frontier models score 0-1% on harmful actions, while DeepSeek V3.2 murders at 100%, leaks at 98%, and blackmails at 94% under permissive conditions.

entry.title: Generative Recursive Reasoning

author.name: Junyeob Baek, Mingyu Jo, Minsu Kim, Mengye Ren, Yoshua Bengio, Sungjin Ahn

entry.summary: Introduces GRAM (Generative Recursive Reasoning Models), extending deterministic Recursive Reasoning Models with probabilistic multi-trajectory computation. Enables multiple hypotheses and parallel trajectory sampling for inference-time scaling. Authors include Yoshua Bengio.

entry.title: ScheduleFree+: Scaling Learning-Rate-Free & Schedule-Free Learning to Large Language Models

author.name: Aaron Defazio

entry.summary: Presents ScheduleFree+, a learning-rate-free and schedule-free optimizer for training large language models that outperforms WSD schedules by 31% at 1000 tokens/parameter scale.

entry.title: Measuring Safety Alignment Effects in Autonomous Security Agents

author.name: Isaac David, Arthur Gervais

entry.summary: Benchmarks safety-aligned vs. uncensored/abliterated LLMs as autonomous security agents across 30 vulnerability analysis tasks. Finds that Gemma pairs show large behavioral differences between aligned and abliterated versions in security agent contexts.

entry.title: Provably Learning Diffusion Models under the Manifold Hypothesis: Collapse and Refine

author.name: Wei Huang, Andi Han, Mingyuan Bai, Huanjian Zhou, Qixin Zhang, Taiji Suzuki, Kenji Fukumizu

entry.summary: Provides theoretical explanation for how diffusion models learn score functions efficiently on low-dimensional manifolds, identifying a 'collapse-and-refine' mechanism where score singularities drive dimensional collapse onto the data manifold at small noise scales.

entry.title: You Only Need Minimal RLVR Training: Extrapolating LLMs via Rank-1 Trajectories

author.name: Zhepei Wei, Xinyu Zhu, Wei-Lin Chen, Chengsong Huang, Jiaxin Huang, Yu Meng

entry.summary: Demonstrates that RLVR weight trajectories are extremely low-rank and predictable, with majority of gains captured by rank-1 approximation. Proposes RELEX to extrapolate from short training windows, dramatically reducing compute.

entry.title: Conditioning Gaussian Processes on Almost Anything

author.name: Henry Moss, Lachlan Astfalck, Thomas Cowperthwaite, Colin Doumont, Sam Willis, Philipp Hennig, Christopher Nemeth, Andrew Zammit-Mangion

entry.summary: Establishes equivalence between Gaussian processes and linear diffusion models, enabling GP conditioning on any statement admitting pointwise likelihood evaluation, including natural language via LLMs, for the first time.

entry.title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Distribution Matching for Diverse Reasoning

author.name: Xiaozhe Li, Yang Li, Xinyu Fang, Shengyuan Ding, Peiji Li, Yongkang Chen, Yichuan Ma, Tianyi Lyu, Linyang Li, Dahua Lin, Qipeng Guo, Qingwen Liu, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DMPO (Distribution-Matching Policy Optimization) to prevent mode collapse in on-policy RL methods like GRPO by approximating forward KL minimization. Shows mode collapse stems from reverse KL's mode-seeking behavior that reinforces the first high-reward trajectory.

entry.title: Block-Based Double Decoders

author.name: Asher Labovich, Benjamin Bradley, Vanessa Alexander, Chaitanya Harsha

entry.summary: Proposes block-based double decoders, a transformer architecture using doubly-causal block-based attention masks that combines decoder-only training efficiency with encoder-decoder inference efficiency, cutting KV-cache memory by at least 2/3.

entry.title: Detecting Fluent Optimization-Based Adversarial Prompts via Sequential Entropy Changes

author.name: Mohammed Alshaalan, Miguel R. D. Rodrigues

entry.summary: Proposes CPD Online, a training-free adversarial suffix detector that casts detection as online change-point detection over token-level entropy streams. Achieves improved F1 over perplexity-based methods against multiple attack types.

entry.title: Does Code Cleanliness Affect Coding Agents? A Controlled Minimal-Pair Study

author.name: Priyansh Trivedi (SonarSource), Olivier Schmitt (SonarSource)

entry.summary: Studies whether code cleanliness (structural quality, style) affects coding agents' performance. Uses minimal pairs of repositories that differ only in code quality to isolate the effect, finding measurable impact.

entry.title: Spectral Souping: A Unified Framework for Online Preference Alignment

author.name: Yinlam Chow, Guy Tennenholtz, Ted Yun, James Harrison, Arthur Gretton, Andre Barreto, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Introduces Spectral Souping, a framework for personalized LLM alignment that discovers a universal spectral representation amenable to model merging, learning offline policy bases that are combined at inference time via water-filling for individual user preferences.

entry.title: Training Language Agents to Learn from Experience

author.name: Yuval Shalev, Zifeng Ding, Mateja Jamnik

entry.summary: Proposes DITTO, training LLMs to simulate human behavior by treating verbal feedback (subjective, multi-faceted) as a first-class signal in reinforcement learning, moving beyond scalar rewards used in code/math domains.

entry.title: On the Cost and Benefit of Chain of Thought: A Learning-Theoretic Perspective

author.name: Yue Zhang, Zhiyi Dong, Tommaso Cesari, Yongyi Mao

entry.summary: Develops a learning-theoretic framework for Chain of Thought reasoning, decomposing reasoning risk into oracle-trajectory risk (benefit of CoT) and trajectory-mismatch risk (cost from error accumulation). Shows structural assumptions are necessary for CoT to help.

entry.title: Pseudo-Formalization for Automatic Proof Verification

author.name: Slim Barkallah, Luke Bailey, Kaiyue Wen, Mohammed Abouzaid, Tengyu Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Pseudo-Formalization (PF), a proof format that captures modularity and precision of formal proofs while retaining natural language flexibility, enabling more reliable verification of AI-generated mathematical proofs without full formalization in Lean.

entry.title: FlowLM: Few-Step Language Modeling via Diffusion-to-Flow Adaptation

author.name: Runzhe Zhang, Letian Chen, Wenpeng Zhang, Zhouhan Lin, Peilin Zhao

entry.summary: FlowLM converts pre-trained diffusion language models into flow matching models via efficient fine-tuning, enabling high-quality few-step generation that rivals 2000-step diffusion sampling. Demonstrates that straightening sampling trajectories dramatically reduces inference steps needed.

entry.title: Towards Context-Invariant Safety Alignment for Large Language Models

author.name: Yixu Wang, Yang Yao, Xin Wang, Yifeng Gao, Yan Teng, Xingjun Ma, Yingchun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes context-invariant safety alignment for LLMs where behavior depends on underlying intent rather than surface form. Uses asymmetric invariance regularization that anchors uncertain predictions toward verifiable contexts rather than applying symmetric constraints.

entry.title: Platonic Representations in the Human Brain: Unsupervised Recovery of Universal Geometry

author.name: Pablo Marcos-Manch\'on, Rishi Jha, Llu\'is Fuentemilla

entry.summary: Tests the Strong Platonic Representation Hypothesis on human brains using fMRI data, showing that independently learned brain embeddings can be translated across subjects using unsupervised orthogonal rotations without paired cross-subject data.

entry.title: Backtracking When It Strays: Mitigating Dual Exposure Biases in LLM Reasoning Distillation

author.name: Bing Wang, Shaotian Yan, Chen Shen, kaiyuan liu, Sinan Fan, Ximing Li, Rui Miao, Xiaosong Yuan, Zhanming Shen, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Addresses dual exposure biases in LLM reasoning distillation: off-policy distillation suffers from distribution mismatch, while on-policy distillation lets students explore suboptimal paths. Proposes a backtracking mechanism that mitigates both biases for more effective chain-of-thought transfer.

entry.title: Stitched Value Model for Diffusion Alignment

author.name: Hyojun Go, Hyungjin Chung, Prune Truong, Goutam Bhat, Li Mi, Zhaochong An, Zixiang Zhao, Dominik Narnhofer, Serge Belongie, Federico Tombari, Konrad Schindler

entry.summary: Proposes a stitched value model for aligning diffusion models with task-specific rewards, addressing the challenge of estimating value functions at noisy intermediate latents. Bridges the bias-cost tradeoff between Tweedie and Monte Carlo approaches.

entry.title: Probability-Conserving Flow Guidance

author.name: Parsa Esmati, Junha Hyung, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Jaegul Choo, Majid Mirmehdi

entry.summary: Analyzes guidance in diffusion/flow models through the continuity equation, showing CFG breaks probability conservation. Proposes a principled guidance method that maintains probability conservation with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: MiMuon: Mixed Muon Optimizer with Improved Generalization for Large Models

author.name: Feihu Huang, Yuning Luo, Songcan Chen

entry.summary: Provides generalization error bounds for the Muon optimizer and proposes MiMuon, a mixed optimizer combining Muon with vector-wise methods. Proves generalization error of O(1/Nκ^T) and demonstrates improved generalization for large models.

entry.title: Equilibrium Reasoners: Learning Attractors Enables Scalable Reasoning

author.name: Benhao Huang, Zhengyang Geng, Zico Kolter

entry.summary: Equilibrium Reasoners (EqR) formalize reasoning as learning task-conditioned attractors in latent dynamics, enabling test-time scaling through depth (more iterations) and breadth (stochastic trajectories) without external verifiers.

entry.title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention

author.name: Shafayeth Jamil, Rehan Kapadia

entry.summary: Decomposes attention's QK^T matrix into skew-symmetric (routing) and symmetric (filtering) components, finding that routing operates at surprisingly low rank. Proposes S-D attention as a diagnostic parameterization.

entry.title: Position: Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs is Just Unsupervised Clustering

author.name: Tiejin Chen, Longchao Da, Xiaoou Liu, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Argues that mainstream uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs are essentially unsupervised clustering algorithms measuring internal consistency rather than external correctness, making them blind to confident hallucinations.

entry.title: TORQ: Two-Level Orthogonal Rotation for MXFP4 Quantization

author.name: Zukang Xu, Xing Hu, Dawei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes TORQ, a two-level orthogonal rotation method for MXFP4 activation quantization of LLMs. Theoretically analyzes error sources (inter-block variance and intra-block codebook utilization imbalances) and addresses them for hardware-efficient 4-bit inference.

entry.title: CopT: Contrastive On-Policy Thinking with Continuous Spaces for General and Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Dachuan Shi, Hanlin Zhu, Xiangchi Yuan, Wanjia Zhao, Kejing Xia, Wen Xiao, Wenke Lee

entry.summary: Introduces CopT, reversing the typical think-then-answer paradigm to answer-then-think. First generates a draft answer, then performs on-policy thinking conditioned on it for reflection and correction, using contrastive learning in continuous spaces.

entry.title: Less Data, Faster Training: repeating smaller datasets speeds up learning via sampling biases

author.name: Jingwen Liu, Ezra Edelman, Surbhi Goel, Bingbin Liu

entry.summary: Investigates why repeating training on smaller datasets can speed up learning compared to using larger datasets, arguing the speedup comes from layer-wise growth enabled by sampling biases that are more pronounced with smaller data.

entry.title: Group-Algebraic Tensors: Provably-optimal Equivariant Learning and Physical Symmetry Discovery

author.name: Paulina Hoyos, Shashanka Ubaru, Dongsung Huh, Vasileios Kalantzis, Kenneth L. Clarkson, Misha Kilmer, Haim Avron, Lior Horesh

entry.summary: Introduces the star-G tensor algebra where any finite group defines the multiplication rule, making equivariance intrinsic rather than architectural, with Lean 4 formalization and provably-optimal SVD guarantees.

entry.title: Most Transformer Modifications Still Do Not Transfer at 1-3B: A 2020-2026 Update to Narang et al. (2021) with Downstream Evaluation and a Noise Floor

author.name: Yang Zhao, Jiahao Lu, Bin Huang, Guhua Zhang, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Tests 20 post-2021 Transformer modifications at 1.2B and 3B scale under strict controls, finding that most still do not transfer—reproducing Narang et al. (2021)'s conclusion at larger scale with downstream evaluation.

entry.title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers

author.name: Aleksandros Sobczyk, Gioele Gottardo, Christos K. Matzoros, Mirko De Vita, Filip Skogh, Anastasios Zouzias, Jiawei Zhuang

entry.summary: Provides systematic analysis of triangular inversion algorithms for Delta-Rule linear transformers, targeting numerical stability and performance. Directly relevant to production models like Qwen3.5/3.6, Kimi Linear, and RWKV-7.

entry.title: STELLAR: Scaling 3D Perception Large Models for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yingwei Li, Xin Huang, Yang Liu, Yang Fu, Alex Zihao Zhu, Chen Song, Junwen Yao, Anant Subramanian, Hao Xiang, Weijing Shi, Yuliang Zou, Tom Hoddes, Zhaoqi Leng, Govind Thattai, Dragomir Anguelov, Mingxing Tan

entry.summary: STELLAR scales 3D perception for autonomous driving by extending Sparse Window Transformers to fuse LiDAR, radar, camera, and map priors, training on 50M examples with up to 500M parameters to study scaling laws for driving perception.

entry.title: Memorisation, convergence and generalisation in generative models

author.name: Antoine Maillard, Sebastian Goldt
